<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Inventory;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class AdminInventoryController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the Master Inventory dashboard and Proactive Action Center.
     */
    public function index()
    {
        // 1. Fetch the main inventory list with pagination and eager load the assignee
        $inventories = Inventory::with('assignee')->latest()->paginate(15);

        // 2. Calculate Low Stock Alerts (Quantity <= Reorder Level)
        $lowStockAlerts = Inventory::whereNotNull('reorder_level')
            ->whereColumn('quantity', '<=', 'reorder_level')
            ->get();

        // 3. Calculate Expiring / End-of-Life Alerts (Expires within the next 90 days)
        $expiringAlerts = Inventory::whereNotNull('expiry_date')
            ->where('expiry_date', '<=', Carbon::now()->addDays(90))
            ->orderBy('expiry_date', 'asc')
            ->get();

        return view('admin.inventory.index', compact('inventories', 'lowStockAlerts', 'expiringAlerts'));
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for manually creating a new asset.
     */
    public function create()
    {
        // Fetch users to populate the "Assigned To" dropdown (Teachers, Staff, etc.)
        $users = User::orderBy('last_name')->get();
        
        return view('admin.inventory.create', compact('users'));
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created asset in storage.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'item_name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'category' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'property_number' => 'nullable|string|unique:inventories,property_number|max:255',
            'lifespan_type' => 'required|in:Non-Expendable,Semi-Expendable,Consumable',
            'quantity' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'unit' => 'required|string|max:50',
            'condition' => 'required|in:Serviceable,Needs Minor Repair,Needs Major Repair,Unserviceable,Missing',
            'reorder_level' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'assignment_type' => 'required|in:Facility,Personal',
            'location' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'assigned_to' => 'nullable|exists:users,id',
            'funding_source' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'date_acquired' => 'nullable|date',
            'expiry_date' => 'nullable|date',
            'photo' => 'nullable|image|max:2048', // Max 2MB image
        ]);

        // Handle Photo Upload
        if ($request->hasFile('photo')) {
            $validated['photo_path'] = $request->file('photo')->store('inventory_photos', 'public');
        }

        // Remove the 'photo' key from the array as we use 'photo_path' in the DB
        unset($validated['photo']);

        Inventory::create($validated);

        return redirect()->route('admin.inventory.index')
            ->with('success', 'New asset successfully registered to the Master Inventory.');
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for editing the specified asset.
     */
    public function edit(Inventory $inventory)
    {
        $users = User::orderBy('last_name')->get();
        return view('admin.inventory.edit', compact('inventory', 'users'));
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified asset in storage.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, Inventory $inventory)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'item_name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'category' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'property_number' => 'nullable|string|max:255|unique:inventories,property_number,' . $inventory->id,
            'lifespan_type' => 'required|in:Non-Expendable,Semi-Expendable,Consumable',
            'quantity' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'unit' => 'required|string|max:50',
            'condition' => 'required|in:Serviceable,Needs Minor Repair,Needs Major Repair,Unserviceable,Missing',
            'reorder_level' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
            'assignment_type' => 'required|in:Facility,Personal',
            'location' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'assigned_to' => 'nullable|exists:users,id',
            'funding_source' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'date_acquired' => 'nullable|date',
            'expiry_date' => 'nullable|date',
            'photo' => 'nullable|image|max:2048',
        ]);

        // Handle Photo Upload & Deletion of old photo
        if ($request->hasFile('photo')) {
            if ($inventory->photo_path) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($inventory->photo_path);
            }
            $validated['photo_path'] = $request->file('photo')->store('inventory_photos', 'public');
        }
        
        unset($validated['photo']);

        $inventory->update($validated);

        return redirect()->route('admin.inventory.index')
            ->with('success', 'Asset details have been successfully updated.');
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified asset from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(Inventory $inventory)
    {
        // Delete the photo from storage if it exists
        if ($inventory->photo_path) {
            Storage::disk('public')->delete($inventory->photo_path);
        }

        $inventory->delete();

        return redirect()->route('admin.inventory.index')
            ->with('success', 'Asset has been permanently removed from the registry.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class ClearanceController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): View
    {
        $personnel = User::whereHas('assetAssignments', function ($query) {
            $query->whereNull('released_at')->whereHas('asset', fn ($assetQuery) => $assetQuery->whereIn('condition_status', ['damaged', 'lost']));
        })->with(['assetAssignments.asset'])->get();

        return view('admin.inventory.clearance', compact('personnel'));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\LisStaging;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Imports\Sf1Import;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;

class LisSyncController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Upload page (LIS Sync index)
     */
    public function index()
    {
        // June-based school year default
        $currentMonth = (int) date('n');
        $currentYear  = (int) date('Y');
        $baseStartYear = $currentMonth >= 6 ? $currentYear : $currentYear - 1;

        $defaultSchoolYear = "{$baseStartYear}-" . ($baseStartYear + 1);

        // Rolling years shown in dropdown: previous 3, current, next 1
        $schoolYears = [];
        for ($i = -3; $i <= 1; $i++) {
            $start = $baseStartYear + $i;
            $schoolYears[] = "{$start}-" . ($start + 1);
        }

        $summary = session('sync_summary', [
            'last_run' => LisStaging::max('updated_at'),
            'inserted' => 0,
            'updated'  => 0,
            'skipped'  => 0,
        ]);

        return view('admin.lis_sync.index', compact('schoolYears', 'defaultSchoolYear', 'summary'));
    }

    /**
     * Handle the upload of the official LIS SF1 file using Maatwebsite Excel.
     */
    public function upload(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            // Added mimes validation to ensure only Excel/CSV files pass through
            'sf1_file' => ['required', 'file', 'mimes:xlsx,xls,csv,txt', 'max:10240'], // Max 10MB
            'school_year' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]);

        try {
            // Initialize our custom SF1 Importer
            $import = new Sf1Import($request->input('school_year'));

            // Let Maatwebsite process the Excel file
            Excel::import($import, $request->file('sf1_file'));

            // Update the summary session with the stats from the import class
            session(['sync_summary' => [
                'last_run' => now(),
                'inserted' => $import->inserted,
                'updated'  => $import->updated,
                'skipped'  => 0,
            ]]);

            return redirect()->route('admin.lis_sync.index')
                             ->with('success', "SF1 Processed Successfully! Added: {$import->inserted}, Updated: {$import->updated}");

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            logger()->error('SF1 Import Failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return back()->withErrors(['sf1_file' => 'Failed to process the file. Please ensure it is a valid SF1 format. Error: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Manage records list with search, filter, and pagination
     */
    public function manage(Request $request)
    {
        $schoolYears = LisStaging::select('school_year')
            ->distinct()
            ->orderBy('school_year', 'desc')
            ->pluck('school_year');

        // Optional filters
        $search = $request->input('search');
        $syFilter = $request->input('school_year');

        $query = LisStaging::query();

        if ($syFilter) {
            $query->where('school_year', $syFilter);
        }

        if ($search) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('lrn', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('last_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('first_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $records = $query->orderBy('last_name')->orderBy('first_name')->paginate(20)->withQueryString();

        return view('admin.lis_sync.manage', compact('records', 'schoolYears', 'syFilter', 'search'));
    }

    /**
     * Show edit form for a specific staging record.
     */
    public function edit(LisStaging $lisStaging)
    {
        return view('admin.lis_sync.edit', compact('lisStaging'));
    }

    /**
     * Update staging record.
     */
    public function update(Request $request, LisStaging $lisStaging)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'lrn'            => 'required|string|max:20',
            'last_name'      => 'required|string|max:100',
            'first_name'     => 'required|string|max:100',
            'middle_name'    => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'extension_name' => 'nullable|string|max:10',
            'gender'         => 'nullable|string|max:20',
            'birthdate'      => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'grade_level'    => 'required|string|max:50',
            'section'        => 'required|string|max:100',
            'curriculum'     => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'status'         => 'nullable|string|max:50',
        ]);

        // Prevent updating LRN to an existing one in the same SY
        if (
            $validated['lrn'] !== $lisStaging->lrn
            && LisStaging::where('lrn', $validated['lrn'])
                ->where('school_year', $lisStaging->school_year)
                ->exists()
        ) {
            return back()->withErrors(['lrn' => 'This LRN already exists for this School Year.']);
        }

        $lisStaging->update($validated);

        return redirect()
            ->route('admin.lis_sync.manage', ['school_year' => $lisStaging->school_year])
            ->with('success', 'Record updated successfully.');
    }

    /**
     * Delete a single staging record.
     */
    public function destroy(LisStaging $lisStaging)
    {
        $sy = $lisStaging->school_year;
        $lisStaging->delete();

        return redirect()
            ->route('admin.lis_sync.manage', ['school_year' => $sy])
            ->with('success', 'Record deleted.');
    }

    /**
     * Show absolute reset confirmation form.
     */
    public function resetForm()
    {
        $schoolYears = LisStaging::select('school_year')
            ->distinct()
            ->orderBy('school_year', 'desc')
            ->pluck('school_year');

        return view('admin.lis_sync.reset', compact('schoolYears'));
    }

    /**
     * ABSOLUTE delete all records for a selected SY (type-to-confirm).
     */
    public function resetYear(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'school_year'         => ['required', 'string'],
            'confirm_school_year' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]);

        if ($validated['school_year'] !== $validated['confirm_school_year']) {
            return back()
                ->withErrors(['confirm_school_year' => 'School year confirmation does not match.'])
                ->withInput();
        }

        $sy = $validated['school_year'];

        $deletedCount = DB::transaction(function () use ($sy) {
            $query = LisStaging::query()->where('school_year', $sy);
            $count = (clone $query)->count();

            $builder = (clone $query);

            if (method_exists($builder, 'forceDelete')) {
                $builder->forceDelete();
            } else {
                $builder->delete();
            }

            return $count;
        });

        return redirect()
            ->route('admin.lis_sync.reset')
            ->with('success', "ABSOLUTE DELETE complete: {$deletedCount} record(s) permanently removed for SY {$sy}.");
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Admin\StoreAssetAssignmentRequest;
use App\Models\Asset;
use App\Models\AssetAssignment;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class MasterInventoryController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): View
    {
        $assets = Asset::with('currentAssignment.user')->latest()->get();
        $teachers = User::where('role', 'teacher')->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('last_name')->get();

        return view('admin.inventory.index', compact('assets', 'teachers'));
    }

    public function store(StoreAssetAssignmentRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $asset = Asset::updateOrCreate([
            'serial_number' => $request->string('serial_number')->toString(),
        ], [
            'name' => $request->string('name')->toString(),
            'asset_type' => $request->string('asset_type')->toString(),
            'condition_status' => $request->input('condition_status', 'functional'),
            'status' => 'assigned',
            'notes' => $request->input('notes'),
        ]);

        $asset->assignments()->whereNull('released_at')->update([
            'released_at' => now(),
            'assignment_status' => 'released',
        ]);

        AssetAssignment::create([
            'asset_id' => $asset->id,
            'user_id' => $request->integer('user_id'),
            'assigned_by' => $request->user()->id,
            'assigned_at' => now(),
            'assignment_status' => 'pending_signature',
            'notes' => $request->input('notes'),
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('admin.inventory.index')->with('status', 'Asset assignment recorded successfully.');
    }

    public function update(Request $request, Asset $inventory): RedirectResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'condition_status' => ['required', 'in:functional,damaged,lost,condemned,replaced'],
        ]);

        $inventory->update($data);

        return redirect()->route('admin.inventory.index')->with('status', 'Asset condition updated successfully.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Permission;
use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class PersonnelController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): View
    {
        $users = User::with(['roles', 'permissions'])->orderBy('last_name')->get();
        $permissions = Permission::orderBy('module_name')->orderBy('action_name')->get();
        $roles = Role::all();

        return view('admin.personnel.index', compact('users', 'permissions', 'roles'));
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        // 1. Validation
        $request->validate([
            'employee_id' => 'required|unique:users,employee_id',
            'email'       => 'required|email|unique:users,email',
            'first_name'  => 'required',
            'last_name'   => 'required',
            'password'    => 'required|string|min:8',
            'roles'       => 'required|array',
            'department'  => 'nullable|string', // Added Profiling Field
            'deped_rank'  => 'nullable|string', // Added Profiling Field
        ]);

        // 2. Create User
        $user = User::create([
            'employee_id'       => $request->employee_id,
            'first_name'        => $request->first_name,
            'last_name'         => $request->last_name,
            'name'              => $request->first_name . ' ' . $request->last_name,
            'email'             => $request->email,
            'is_active'         => $request->boolean('is_active', true),
            'password'          => Hash::make($request->password),
            'email_verified_at' => now(),

            // Profiling Additions
            'department'        => $request->department,
            'deped_rank'        => $request->deped_rank,
            'is_verified'       => true,             // Auto-verify since Admin created them
            'verified_by'       => auth()->id(),     // Log which Admin created this account
        ]);

        // 3. Set primary string role fallback
        if (!empty($request->roles)) {
            $primaryRole = Role::find($request->roles[0]);
            if ($primaryRole) {
                $user->role = $primaryRole->name;
                $user->save();
            }
        }

        // 4. Sync Roles
        $user->roles()->sync($request->roles);

        // 5. AUTOMATIC PERMISSION ASSIGNMENT
        $rolesWithPermissions = Role::with('permissions')->whereIn('id', $request->roles)->get();

        $permissionIds = $rolesWithPermissions->flatMap(function ($role) {
            return $role->permissions->pluck('id');
        })->unique()->toArray();

        $user->permissions()->sync($permissionIds);

        return redirect()->route('admin.personnel.index')->with('status', 'Personnel account created and profiled successfully.');
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // THIS IS THE MISSING METHOD THAT FIXES THE ERROR!
    // =========================================================================
    public function edit(User $personnel): View
    {
        $roles = Role::all();
        return view('admin.personnel.edit', compact('personnel', 'roles'));
    }
    // =========================================================================

    public function update(Request $request, User $personnel): RedirectResponse
    {
        // 1. Validation
        $request->validate([
            'employee_id' => 'required|unique:users,employee_id,' . $personnel->id,
            'email'       => 'required|email|unique:users,email,' . $personnel->id,
            'first_name'  => 'required',
            'last_name'   => 'required',
            'roles'       => 'required|array',
            'password'    => 'nullable|string|min:8|confirmed', // Added for the reset password feature
            'department'  => 'nullable|string', // Added Profiling Field
            'deped_rank'  => 'nullable|string', // Added Profiling Field
        ]);

        // 2. Prepare Update Data
        $updateData = [
            'employee_id' => $request->employee_id,
            'email'       => $request->email,
            'first_name'  => $request->first_name,
            'last_name'   => $request->last_name,
            'name'        => $request->first_name . ' ' . $request->last_name,
            'is_active'   => $request->has('is_active') ? $request->boolean('is_active') : $personnel->is_active,
            'department'  => $request->department,
            'deped_rank'  => $request->deped_rank,
        ];

        // Only hash and update the password if the Admin actually typed a new one
        if ($request->filled('password')) {
            $updateData['password'] = Hash::make($request->password);
        }

        // 3. Execute Update
        $personnel->update($updateData);

        // 4. Set primary string role fallback
        if (!empty($request->roles)) {
            $primaryRole = Role::find($request->roles[0]);
            if ($primaryRole) {
                $personnel->role = $primaryRole->name;
                $personnel->save();
            }
        }

        // 5. Sync Roles
        $personnel->roles()->sync($request->roles);

        // 6. AUTOMATIC PERMISSION ASSIGNMENT
        $rolesWithPermissions = Role::with('permissions')->whereIn('id', $request->roles)->get();

        $permissionIds = $rolesWithPermissions->flatMap(function ($role) {
            return $role->permissions->pluck('id');
        })->unique()->toArray();

        $personnel->permissions()->sync($permissionIds);

        return redirect()->route('admin.personnel.index')->with('status', 'Personnel profile updated securely.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Setting;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class SettingController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the System Settings / School Profile page.
     */
    public function index(): View
    {
        // Pluck converts the database rows into a simple key-value array.
        $settings = Setting::pluck('value', 'key')->toArray();

        return view('admin.settings.index', compact('settings'));
    }

    /**
     * Update and save the system settings.
     */
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'school_name'         => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'school_id'           => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
            'default_school_year' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:20'],
            'principal_name'      => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'school_address'      => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500'],
            'school_logo'         => ['nullable', 'image', 'mimes:jpeg,png,jpg', 'max:2048'],
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('school_logo')) {
            $file = $request->file('school_logo');
            $file->move(public_path('images'), 'school-logo.png');
            Setting::set('has_custom_logo', 'true');
        }

        $inputsToSave = $request->except(['_token', 'school_logo']);

        foreach ($inputsToSave as $key => $value) {
            Setting::set($key, $value);
        }

        return redirect()->back()->with('success', 'School Profile and System Settings updated successfully.');
    }
}

FILE: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/AuthenticatedSessionController.php

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Auth\LoginRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class AuthenticatedSessionController extends Controller
{
    public function create(): View
    {
        return view('auth.login');
    }

    public function store(LoginRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->authenticate();
        $request->session()->regenerate();

        $user = Auth::user();
        $rolesCount = $user->roles()->count();

        if ($rolesCount > 1) {
            return redirect()->route('role.select');
        }

        $primaryRole = $user->roles()->first()?->name ?? $user->role;
        session(['active_role' => $primaryRole]);

        // Redirect directly to the dedicated dashboards on login
        return match ($primaryRole) {
            'admin'       => redirect()->route('admin.dashboard'),
            'teacher'     => redirect()->route('teacher.dashboard'),
            'counselor'   => redirect()->route('counselor.dashboard'),
            'school_head' => redirect()->route('school_head.dashboard'),
            default       => redirect()->intended(route('dashboard')),
        };
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->session()->forget('active_role');
        Auth::guard('web')->logout();
        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect('/login');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class ConfirmablePasswordController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Show the confirm password view.
     */
    public function show(): View
    {
        return view('auth.confirm-password');
    }

    /**
     * Confirm the user's password.
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        if (! Auth::guard('web')->validate([
            'email' => $request->user()->email,
            'password' => $request->password,
        ])) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'password' => __('auth.password'),
            ]);
        }

        $request->session()->put('auth.password_confirmed_at', time());

        return redirect()->intended(route('dashboard', absolute: false));
    }
}

FILE: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/NewPasswordController.php
==================================================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Events\PasswordReset;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Password;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class NewPasswordController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the password reset view.
     */
    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        return view('auth.reset-password', ['request' => $request]);
    }

    /**
     * Handle an incoming new password request.
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'token' => ['required'],
            'email' => ['required', 'email'],
            'password' => ['required', 'confirmed', Rules\Password::defaults()],
        ]);

        // Here we will attempt to reset the user's password. If it is successful we
        // will update the password on an actual user model and persist it to the
        // database. Otherwise we will parse the error and return the response.
        $status = Password::reset(
            $request->only('email', 'password', 'password_confirmation', 'token'),
            function (User $user) use ($request) {
                $user->forceFill([
                    'password' => Hash::make($request->password),
                    'remember_token' => Str::random(60),
                ])->save();

                event(new PasswordReset($user));
            }
        );

        // If the password was successfully reset, we will redirect the user back to
        // the application's home authenticated view. If there is an error we can
        // redirect them back to where they came from with their error message.
        return $status == Password::PASSWORD_RESET
                    ? redirect()->route('login')->with('status', __($status))
                    : back()->withInput($request->only('email'))
                        ->withErrors(['email' => __($status)]);
    }
}

FILE: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/PasswordController.php

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;

class PasswordController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Update the user's password.
     */
    public function update(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validateWithBag('updatePassword', [
            'current_password' => ['required', 'current_password'],
            'password' => ['required', Password::defaults(), 'confirmed'],
        ]);

        $request->user()->update([
            'password' => Hash::make($validated['password']),
        ]);

        return back()->with('status', 'password-updated');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Password;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class PasswordResetLinkController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the password reset link request view.
     */
    public function create(): View
    {
        return view('auth.forgot-password');
    }

    /**
     * Handle an incoming password reset link request.
     *
     * @throws ValidationException
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'email' => ['required', 'email'],
        ]);

        // We will send the password reset link to this user. Once we have attempted
        // to send the link, we will examine the response then see the message we
        // need to show to the user. Finally, we'll send out a proper response.
        $status = Password::sendResetLink(
            $request->only('email')
        );

        return $status == Password::RESET_LINK_SENT
                    ? back()->with('status', __($status))
                    : back()->withInput($request->only('email'))
                        ->withErrors(['email' => __($status)]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class RoleSwitchController extends Controller
{
    public function switch(string $role): RedirectResponse
    {
        $user = Auth::user();

        // Security check
        if ($user->role !== 'admin' && !$user->roles()->where('name', $role)->exists()) {
            abort(403, 'You are not authorized to use this workspace.');
        }

        // Set the active session role
        session(['active_role' => $role]);

        // Redirect to their specific dashboard
        return match ($role) {
            'admin'       => redirect()->route('admin.dashboard'),
            'teacher'     => redirect()->route('teacher.dashboard'),
            'counselor'   => redirect()->route('counselor.dashboard'),
            'school_head' => redirect()->route('school_head.dashboard'),
            default       => redirect()->route('dashboard'),
        };
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Auth\Events\Verified;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\EmailVerificationRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;

class VerifyEmailController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Mark the authenticated user's email address as verified.
     */
    public function __invoke(EmailVerificationRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        if ($request->user()->hasVerifiedEmail()) {
            return redirect()->intended(route('dashboard', absolute: false).'?verified=1');
        }

        if ($request->user()->markEmailAsVerified()) {
            event(new Verified($request->user()));
        }

        return redirect()->intended(route('dashboard', absolute: false).'?verified=1');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Counselor;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\IncidentReport;
use App\Models\Student;
use App\Models\PublicTip; // <-- Make sure to add this!
use Illuminate\View\View;

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): View
    {
        // 1. Top Level Snapshot Counts
        $pendingIncidentsCount = IncidentReport::where('status', 'pending')->count();
        $violatorsCount = Student::has('incidentReports')->count();

        // Assuming you have a GoodMoral model, adjust this if yours is different.
        // If you don't have this mapped yet, you can leave it as 0 or your existing logic.
        $certificatesCount = 0;

        // 2. NEW: Action Required Alerts
        $unverifiedTipsCount = PublicTip::where('status', 'unverified')->count();

        // 3. NEW: Quick-Access Work Queue (Latest 4 pending referrals)
        $recentPendingCases = IncidentReport::with(['student', 'teacher'])
            ->where('status', 'pending')
            ->latest('created_at')
            ->take(4)
            ->get();

        // 4. Upgraded Analytics (Now includes Critical)
        $totalIncidents = IncidentReport::count();

        $minorCount = IncidentReport::where('severity', 'minor')->count();
        $majorCount = IncidentReport::where('severity', 'major')->count();
        $criticalCount = IncidentReport::where('severity', 'critical')->count();

        $minorPercentage = $totalIncidents > 0 ? round(($minorCount / $totalIncidents) * 100) : 0;
        $majorPercentage = $totalIncidents > 0 ? round(($majorCount / $totalIncidents) * 100) : 0;
        $criticalPercentage = $totalIncidents > 0 ? round(($criticalCount / $totalIncidents) * 100) : 0;

        return view('counselor.dashboard', compact(
            'pendingIncidentsCount',
            'violatorsCount',
            'certificatesCount',
            'unverifiedTipsCount',
            'recentPendingCases',
            'totalIncidents',
            'minorCount', 'minorPercentage',
            'majorCount', 'majorPercentage',
            'criticalCount', 'criticalPercentage'
        ));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Counselor;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class GoodMoralController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $student = null;
        $targetSy = trim($request->string('target_sy')->toString());

        if ($request->filled('student_lrn') && $request->filled('target_sy')) {
            $lrn = trim($request->string('student_lrn')->toString());

            $student = DB::table('lis_stagings')
                ->where('lrn', $lrn)
                ->where('school_year', $targetSy)
                ->first();

            if ($student) {
                $hasBlockingOffense = DB::table('students')
                    ->join('incident_reports', 'students.id', '=', 'incident_reports.student_id')
                    ->where('students.lrn', $lrn)
                    ->where(function ($query) {
                        $query->where(function ($q) {
                            $q->where('incident_reports.severity', 'major')
                              ->whereNotIn('incident_reports.status', ['resolved', 'overridden']);
                        })->orWhere(function ($q) {
                            $q->where('incident_reports.severity', 'critical')
                              ->where('incident_reports.status', '!=', 'overridden');
                        });
                    })
                    ->exists();

                $student->is_eligible = !$hasBlockingOffense;
                $student->full_name = trim(($student->first_name ?? '') . ' ' . ($student->last_name ?? ''));
            }
        }

        $schoolYear = trim($request->string('school_year')->toString());
        $scope = $request->string('scope')->toString() ?: 'grade';
        $gradeLevel = trim($request->string('grade_level')->toString());
        $gradeLevels = collect(['7', '8', '9', '10', '11', '12']);

        $eligibleCount = null;
        $blockedCount = null;

        if ($schoolYear !== '') {
            if ($scope === 'grade' && $gradeLevel === '') {
                return view('counselor.good_moral.index', [
                    'student' => $student,
                    'schoolYear' => $schoolYear,
                    'scope' => $scope,
                    'gradeLevel' => $gradeLevel,
                    'eligibleCount' => null,
                    'blockedCount' => null,
                ]);
            }

            $base = DB::table('lis_stagings as ls')->where('ls.school_year', $schoolYear);

            // robust grade matching to handle different Excel upload formats
            if ($scope === 'grade') {
                $base->where(function($q) use ($gradeLevel) {
                    $q->where('ls.grade_level', $gradeLevel)
                      ->orWhere('ls.grade_level', 'Grade ' . $gradeLevel)
                      ->orWhere('ls.grade_level', '0' . $gradeLevel);
                });
            } else {
                $base->where(function($q) use ($gradeLevels) {
                    $q->whereIn('ls.grade_level', $gradeLevels->all())
                      ->orWhereIn('ls.grade_level', $gradeLevels->map(fn($g) => "Grade $g")->all())
                      ->orWhereIn('ls.grade_level', $gradeLevels->map(fn($g) => "0$g")->all());
                });
            }

            $rows = (clone $base)
                ->leftJoin('students as s', 's.lrn', '=', 'ls.lrn')
                ->leftJoin('incident_reports as ir', function ($join) {
                    $join->on('ir.student_id', '=', 's.id')
                        ->where(function ($q) {
                            $q->where(function ($sub) {
                                $sub->where('ir.severity', 'major')
                                    ->whereNotIn('ir.status', ['resolved', 'overridden']);
                            })->orWhere(function ($sub) {
                                $sub->where('ir.severity', 'critical')
                                    ->where('ir.status', '!=', 'overridden');
                            });
                        });
                })
                ->groupBy('ls.lrn')
                ->selectRaw("ls.lrn, COUNT(ir.id) as blocking_offense_count")
                ->get();

            $eligibleCount = $rows->filter(fn ($r) => (int) $r->blocking_offense_count === 0)->count();
            $blockedCount  = $rows->filter(fn ($r) => (int) $r->blocking_offense_count > 0)->count();
        }

        return view('counselor.good_moral.index', [
            'student' => $student,
            'schoolYear' => $schoolYear,
            'scope' => $scope,
            'gradeLevel' => $gradeLevel,
            'eligibleCount' => $eligibleCount,
            'blockedCount' => $blockedCount,
        ]);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // RESTORED: Single Certificate Generation
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    public function generate(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'student_lrn' => 'required|string|size:12',
            'target_sy' => 'required|string'
        ]);

        $lrn = trim($request->student_lrn);
        $sy = trim($request->target_sy);

        $student = DB::table('lis_stagings')->where('lrn', $lrn)->where('school_year', $sy)->first();
        abort_unless($student, 404, 'No active enrollment found for this LRN in SY ' . $sy);

        $hasBlockingOffense = DB::table('students')
            ->join('incident_reports', 'students.id', '=', 'incident_reports.student_id')
            ->where('students.lrn', $lrn)
            ->where(function ($query) {
                $query->where(function ($q) {
                    $q->where('incident_reports.severity', 'major')
                      ->whereNotIn('incident_reports.status', ['resolved', 'overridden']);
                })->orWhere(function ($q) {
                    $q->where('incident_reports.severity', 'critical')
                      ->where('incident_reports.status', '!=', 'overridden');
                });
            })
            ->exists();

        abort_if($hasBlockingOffense, 422, 'Student is blocked due to major/critical infractions.');

        $student->full_name = trim(($student->first_name ?? '') . ' ' . ($student->last_name ?? ''));

        $content = view('counselor.good_moral.certificate', compact('student'))->render();
        $filename = Str::slug($student->full_name ?: $lrn) . '-good-moral-' . Str::slug($sy) . '.html';

        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($content) {
            echo $content;
        }, $filename, ['Content-Type' => 'text/html; charset=UTF-8']);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    // BATCH GENERATION
    // -------------------------------------------------------------
    public function generateBatch(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'school_year' => ['required', 'string'],
            'scope' => ['required', 'in:grade,all'],
            'grade_level' => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ]);

        $schoolYear = trim($validated['school_year']);
        $scope = $validated['scope'];
        $gradeLevel = trim($validated['grade_level'] ?? '');
        $gradeLevels = collect(['7', '8', '9', '10', '11', '12']);

        if ($scope === 'grade' && $gradeLevel === '') abort(422, 'Grade required.');

        $base = DB::table('lis_stagings as ls')->where('ls.school_year', $schoolYear);

        if ($scope === 'grade') {
            $base->where(function($q) use ($gradeLevel) {
                $q->where('ls.grade_level', $gradeLevel)
                  ->orWhere('ls.grade_level', 'Grade ' . $gradeLevel)
                  ->orWhere('ls.grade_level', '0' . $gradeLevel);
            });
        } else {
            $base->where(function($q) use ($gradeLevels) {
                $q->whereIn('ls.grade_level', $gradeLevels->all())
                  ->orWhereIn('ls.grade_level', $gradeLevels->map(fn($g) => "Grade $g")->all())
                  ->orWhereIn('ls.grade_level', $gradeLevels->map(fn($g) => "0$g")->all());
            });
        }

        $rows = (clone $base)
            ->leftJoin('students as s', 's.lrn', '=', 'ls.lrn')
            ->leftJoin('incident_reports as ir', function ($join) {
                $join->on('ir.student_id', '=', 's.id')
                    ->where(function ($q) {
                        $q->where(function ($sub) {
                            $sub->where('ir.severity', 'major')
                                ->whereNotIn('ir.status', ['resolved', 'overridden']);
                        })->orWhere(function ($sub) {
                            $sub->where('ir.severity', 'critical')
                                ->where('ir.status', '!=', 'overridden');
                        });
                    });
            })
            // Added ls.id to ensure the certificate gets a unique ID if available!
            ->groupBy(
                'ls.id',
                'ls.lrn',
                'ls.first_name',
                'ls.last_name',
                'ls.middle_name',
                'ls.extension_name',
                'ls.grade_level',
                'ls.section',
                'ls.school_year'
            )
            ->selectRaw("
                ls.id,
                ls.lrn,
                ls.first_name,
                ls.last_name,
                ls.middle_name,
                ls.extension_name,
                ls.grade_level,
                ls.section,
                ls.school_year,
                COUNT(ir.id) as blocking_offense_count
            ")
            ->orderBy('ls.last_name')
            ->orderBy('ls.first_name')
            ->get();

        $eligible = $rows->filter(fn ($r) => (int) $r->blocking_offense_count === 0)->values();

        foreach($eligible as $student) {
            $student->full_name = trim(($student->first_name ?? '') . ' ' . ($student->last_name ?? ''));
        }

        $content = view('counselor.good_moral.batch', [
            'students' => $eligible,
            'schoolYear' => $schoolYear,
            'scope' => $scope,
            'gradeLevel' => $gradeLevel,
        ])->render();

        $fileBase = $scope === 'all' ? "good-moral-eligible-SY-{$schoolYear}-all-grades" : "good-moral-eligible-SY-{$schoolYear}-grade-{$gradeLevel}";

        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($content) {
            echo $content;
        }, Str::slug($fileBase) . '.html', ['Content-Type' => 'text/html; charset=UTF-8']);
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Counselor;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Student;
use App\Models\IncidentReport;
use App\Models\PublicTip; // <-- NEW: Added PublicTip model
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class IncidentReviewController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * ==========================================
     * NEW: ACTIVE INTAKE QUEUE
     * ==========================================
     */
    public function queue(): View
    {
        // 1. Fetch Official Teacher Referrals waiting for Counselor review
        $pendingReferrals = IncidentReport::with(['student', 'teacher'])
            ->where('status', 'pending')
            ->latest('created_at')
            ->get();

        // 2. Fetch Unverified Public QR Tips (NOW LIVE!)
        $unverifiedTips = PublicTip::where('status', 'unverified')
            ->latest('created_at')
            ->get();

        return view('counselor.incidents.queue', compact('pendingReferrals', 'unverifiedTips'));
    }

    /**
     * Active cases (work queue)
     */
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $q = trim((string) $request->query('q', ''));

        $incidentReports = IncidentReport::with(['student', 'teacher'])
            ->whereIn('status', ['pending', 'in_intervention']) // active queue
            ->when($q !== '', function ($query) use ($q) {
                $query->where(function ($sub) use ($q) {
                    $sub->where('offense_type', 'like', "%{$q}%")
                        ->orWhere('narrative', 'like', "%{$q}%")
                        ->orWhereHas('student', function ($s) use ($q) {
                            $s->where('lrn', 'like', "%{$q}%")
                              ->orWhere('first_name', 'like', "%{$q}%")
                              ->orWhere('last_name', 'like', "%{$q}%");
                        });
                });
            })
            ->latest('incident_date')
            ->paginate(15)
            ->withQueryString();

        return view('counselor.incidents.index', compact('incidentReports', 'q'));
    }

    /**
     * Create page - supports prefill_lrn
     */
    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        $prefillLrn = $request->query('prefill_lrn');
        return view('counselor.incidents.create', compact('prefillLrn'));
    }

    public function searchLis(Request $request)
    {
        try {
            $query = trim($request->query('q', ''));

            if (strlen($query) < 2) {
                return response()->json([]);
            }

            $results = DB::table('lis_stagings')
                ->where(function ($q) use ($query) {
                    $q->where('lrn', 'LIKE', '%' . $query . '%')
                        ->orWhere('first_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $query . '%')
                        ->orWhere('last_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $query . '%');
                })
                ->orderBy('last_name')
                ->limit(10)
                ->get(['lrn', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'grade_level', 'section']);

            return response()->json($results);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json(['error' => $e->getMessage()], 500);
        }
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        // 1. Validate for an array of LRNs and the new 'other' intervention field
        $request->validate([
            'lrns'              => 'required|array|min:1',
            'lrns.*'            => 'required|string',
            'offense_type'      => 'required|string|max:255',
            'severity'          => 'required|in:minor,major,critical',
            'narrative'         => 'required|string',
            'incident_date'     => 'required|date',
            'intervention_type' => 'required|string',
            'intervention_custom'=> 'required_if:intervention_type,other|nullable|string|max:255',
            'status'            => 'required|in:in_intervention,resolved,escalated,turned_over,pending',
            'scheduled_at'      => 'nullable|date',
            'notes'             => 'nullable|string',
            'evidence_photo'    => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,gif|max:2048',
            'redirect_to'       => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $path = null;
        if ($request->hasFile('evidence_photo')) {
            $path = $request->file('evidence_photo')->store('incident_evidence', 'public');
        }

        $finalIntervention = $request->intervention_type === 'other'
            ? $request->intervention_custom
            : $request->intervention_type;

        $isGroup = count($request->lrns) > 1;
        $finalNarrative = $isGroup
            ? "[GROUP INCIDENT] " . $request->narrative
            : $request->narrative;

        $firstStudentId = null;

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $path, $finalIntervention, $finalNarrative, &$firstStudentId) {

            foreach ($request->lrns as $index => $lrn) {
                $stagedStudent = DB::table('lis_stagings')->where('lrn', $lrn)->first();

                if (!$stagedStudent) {
                    abort(404, "Student with LRN {$lrn} not found in LIS records.");
                }

                $student = Student::firstOrCreate(
                    ['lrn' => $stagedStudent->lrn],
                    [
                        'first_name'  => $stagedStudent->first_name ?? 'Unknown',
                        'last_name'   => $stagedStudent->last_name ?? 'Unknown',
                        'middle_name' => $stagedStudent->middle_name ?? null,
                        'grade_level' => $stagedStudent->grade_level ?? null,
                        'section'     => $stagedStudent->section ?? null,
                    ]
                );

                if ($index === 0) {
                    $firstStudentId = $student->id;
                }

                IncidentReport::create([
                    'student_id'        => $student->id,
                    'teacher_id'        => auth()->id(),
                    'offense_type'      => $request->offense_type,
                    'severity'          => $request->severity,
                    'narrative'         => $finalNarrative,
                    'incident_date'     => $request->incident_date,
                    'status'            => $request->status,
                    'intervention_type' => $finalIntervention,
                    'scheduled_at'      => $request->scheduled_at,
                    'counselor_notes'   => $request->notes,
                    'evidence_path'     => $path,
                ]);
            }
        });

        if ($request->filled('redirect_to')) {
            return redirect($request->string('redirect_to')->toString())
                ->with('status', 'Behavioral incident successfully logged.');
        }

        if (count($request->lrns) === 1 && $firstStudentId) {
            return redirect()->route('counselor.violators.show', $firstStudentId)
                ->with('status', 'Behavioral incident successfully logged.');
        }

        return redirect()->route('counselor.incidents.index')
            ->with('status', 'Group behavioral incident successfully logged.');
    }

    public function resolve(Request $request, IncidentReport $incident): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'status'            => 'required|in:in_intervention,resolved,escalated,turned_over,pending',
            'intervention_type' => 'nullable|string',
            'scheduled_at'      => 'nullable|date',
            'principal_action'  => 'nullable|string',
            'notes'             => 'required|string',
            'redirect_to'       => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $incident->update([
            'status'            => $request->status,
            'intervention_type' => $request->intervention_type,
            'scheduled_at'      => $request->scheduled_at,
            'principal_action'  => $request->principal_action,
            'notes'             => $request->notes,
        ]);

        if ($request->filled('redirect_to')) {
            return redirect($request->string('redirect_to')->toString())
                ->with('status', 'Incident case updated successfully.');
        }

        return back()->with('status', 'Incident case updated successfully.');
    }

    public function edit(IncidentReport $incident): View
    {
        $incident->load(['student', 'teacher']);
        return view('counselor.incidents.edit', compact('incident'));
    }

    public function update(Request $request, IncidentReport $incident): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'offense_type'      => 'required|string|max:255',
            'severity'          => 'required|in:minor,major,critical',
            'narrative'         => 'required|string',
            'incident_date'     => 'required|date',
            'status'            => 'required|in:in_intervention,resolved,escalated,turned_over,pending',
            'notes'             => 'nullable|string',
            'evidence_photo'    => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,gif|max:2048',
            'redirect_to'       => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $data = [
            'offense_type'    => $request->offense_type,
            'severity'        => $request->severity,
            'narrative'       => $request->narrative,
            'incident_date'   => $request->incident_date,
            'status'          => $request->status,
            'counselor_notes' => $request->notes,
        ];

        if ($request->hasFile('evidence_photo')) {
            if ($incident->evidence_path) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($incident->evidence_path);
            }
            $data['evidence_path'] = $request->file('evidence_photo')->store('incident_evidence', 'public');
        }

        $incident->update($data);

        if ($request->filled('redirect_to')) {
            return redirect($request->string('redirect_to')->toString())
                ->with('status', 'Incident record updated securely.');
        }

        return redirect()->route('counselor.violators.show', $incident->student_id)
            ->with('status', 'Incident record updated securely.');
    }

    public function printQr(): View
    {
        $publicReportUrl = url('/report/tip');
        return view('counselor.incidents.qr-print', compact('publicReportUrl'));
    }

    // Add these methods inside IncidentReviewController

    public function toggleIntake(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        // Toggle the global cache flag
        $currentState = cache('public_intake_enabled', true);
        cache()->forever('public_intake_enabled', !$currentState);

        $status = !$currentState ? 'activated' : 'terminated';

        return back()->with('success', "The Public QR Intake link has been {$status}.");
    }

    public function triageTip(PublicTip $tip): View
    {
        // Prevent triaging an already processed tip
        if ($tip->status !== 'unverified') {
            abort(404, 'This tip has already been processed.');
        }

        return view('counselor.incidents.triage', compact('tip'));
    }

    public function processTriage(Request $request, PublicTip $tip): RedirectResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'action' => 'required|in:dismissed,turned_over_external'
        ]);

        // Update the tip status to remove it from the Active Queue
        $tip->update(['status' => $validated['action']]);

        // Set a dynamic success message based on the action
        $message = $validated['action'] === 'dismissed'
            ? 'Tip has been dismissed and archived as spam.'
            : 'Tip has been marked as Turned Over to External Authorities.';

        return redirect()->route('counselor.incidents.queue')->with('success', $message);
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, IncidentReport $incident): RedirectResponse
    {
        $redirectTo = $request->input('redirect_to');

        if ($incident->evidence_path) {
            Storage::disk('public')->delete($incident->evidence_path);
        }

        $studentId = $incident->student_id;
        $incident->delete();

        if (!empty($redirectTo)) {
            return redirect($redirectTo)->with('status', 'Incident record permanently deleted.');
        }

        if (!empty($studentId)) {
            return redirect()->route('counselor.violators.show', $studentId)
                ->with('status', 'Incident record permanently deleted.');
        }

        return redirect()->route('counselor.incidents.index')
            ->with('status', 'Incident record permanently deleted.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Counselor;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Student;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class ViolatorController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $search = trim((string) $request->query('q', ''));

        $students = Student::has('incidentReports')
            ->withCount('incidentReports')
            ->with(['incidentReports' => fn ($query) => $query->latest('incident_date')])
            ->when($search !== '', function ($query) use ($search) {
                $query->where(function ($subQuery) use ($search) {
                    $subQuery->where('lrn', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                        ->orWhere('first_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                        ->orWhere('last_name', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                });
            })
            ->orderByDesc('incident_reports_count')
            ->paginate(15)
            ->withQueryString();

        return view('counselor.violators.index', compact('students', 'search'));
    }

    public function show($id): View
    {
        $student = Student::with([
            'incidentReports' => function ($query) {
                $query->orderBy('incident_date', 'desc')->with('teacher');
            }
        ])->findOrFail($id);

        return view('counselor.violators.show', compact('student'));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $user = Auth::user();

        // 1. Check if they selected a specific workspace session.
        // 2. If not, fall back to their primary database role.
        $activeRole = session('active_role', $user->role);

        // Redirect to the specific isolated controllers based on workspace
        switch ($activeRole) {
            case 'admin':
                return redirect()->route('admin.dashboard');
            case 'teacher':
                return redirect()->route('teacher.dashboard');
            case 'counselor':
                // This redirect triggers your Counselor/DashboardController to run its math!
                return redirect()->route('counselor.dashboard');
            case 'school_head':
                return redirect()->route('school_head.dashboard');
            default:
                return view('dashboard');
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class GlobalCopilotController extends Controller
{
    public function handlePrompt(Request $request)
    {
        $promptId = $request->input('prompt_id');

        // Grab the user's role to make the AI feel personalized
        $role = Auth::user()->role ?? 'guest';

        $responses = [
            'system_nav' => "🗺️ **System Navigation**\n\nTrackEd is divided into specialized workspaces. Use the dark sidebar on the left to switch between your available modules. Your profile and account settings are located in the top-right dropdown menu.",

            'dll_help' => "📚 **Smart Lesson Logs (DLL)**\n\nThe Daily Matrix allows you to build lesson plans using either the ILAW or MATATAG framework. As you type your Intentions, you can click the '✨ Suggest' buttons to have my local engine generate DepEd-aligned pedagogies instantly!",

            'role_duty' => $this->getRoleDuty($role)
        ];

        // Fetch the corresponding answer, or a fallback if something goes wrong
        $reply = $responses[$promptId] ?? "I'm sorry, I don't have information on that topic right now.";

        return response()->json(['message' => $reply]);
    }

    /**
     * AI Heuristic: Customizes the answer based on who is logged in.
     */
    private function getRoleDuty(string $role): string
    {
        return match ($role) {
            'teacher' => "👥 **Faculty Responsibilities**\n\nAs a Teacher, your primary duties in TrackEd are to maintain your Daily Lesson Logs (DLL), log behavioral incidents in your classes, and manage your assigned classroom inventory.",

            'school_head', 'admin' => "👥 **Executive Responsibilities**\n\nAs a School Head, you are responsible for auditing submitted Daily Lesson Logs, providing Technical Assistance, and reviewing school-wide Decision Support System (DSS) analytics.",

            'counselor' => "👥 **Counselor Responsibilities**\n\nAs a Counselor, your workspace is focused on reviewing behavioral incident reports, managing interventions, and processing Good Moral certificate requests.",

            default => "👥 **System User**\n\nPlease refer to your department head for your specific administrative duties within the TrackEd platform."
        };
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Requests\ProfileUpdateRequest;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Redirect;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class ProfileController extends Controller
{
    public function edit(Request $request): View
    {
        return view('profile.edit', [
            'user' => $request->user(),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(ProfileUpdateRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->user()->fill($request->validated());

        if ($request->user()->isDirty('email')) {
            $request->user()->email_verified_at = null;
        }

        $request->user()->save();

        return Redirect::route('profile.edit')->with('status', 'profile-updated');
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validateWithBag('userDeletion', [
            'password' => ['required', 'current_password'],
        ]);

        $user = $request->user();

        Auth::logout();

        $user->delete();

        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return Redirect::to('/');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\PublicTip;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;

class PublicTipController extends Controller
{
    public function create(): View
    {
        // THE KILL SWITCH CHECK
        if (!cache('public_intake_enabled', true)) {
            abort(403, 'The school administration has temporarily disabled the public intake form.');
        }

        return view('public.report-tip');
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        // THE KILL SWITCH CHECK
        if (!cache('public_intake_enabled', true)) {
            abort(403, 'The school administration has temporarily disabled the public intake form.');
        }
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'is_anonymous'      => 'nullable|boolean',
            'reporter_name'     => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'reporter_contact'  => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'incident_location' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'narrative'         => 'required|string|min:10',
            'evidence_photo'    => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:5120', // 5MB limit
            'video_link'        => 'nullable|url|max:255',
        ]);

        $evidencePath = null;
        if ($request->hasFile('evidence_photo')) {
            $evidencePath = $request->file('evidence_photo')->store('public_tips', 'public');
        }

        // Enforce anonymity if the box was checked
        if ($request->filled('is_anonymous')) {
            $validated['reporter_name'] = null;
            $validated['reporter_contact'] = null;
        }

        PublicTip::create([
            'reporter_name'     => $validated['reporter_name'] ?? null,
            'reporter_contact'  => $validated['reporter_contact'] ?? null,
            'incident_location' => $validated['incident_location'],
            'narrative'         => $validated['narrative'],
            'evidence_path'     => $evidencePath,
            'video_link'        => $validated['video_link'] ?? null,
            'status'            => 'unverified',
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('public.tip.create')
            ->with('success', 'Your report has been securely submitted. Thank you for helping keep the campus safe.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\SchoolHead;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\IncidentReport;
use App\Models\Student;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class BehavioralOversightController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * 1. Behavioral Analytics Dashboard (Flexible Dates)
     */
    /**
     * 1. Behavioral Analytics Dashboard (Flexible Dates)
     */
    public function analytics(Request $request): View
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'start_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'end_date'   => ['nullable', 'date', 'after_or_equal:start_date'],
        ]);

        $from = $validated['start_date'] ?? now()->subDays(30)->toDateString();
        $to   = $validated['end_date'] ?? now()->toDateString();

        $baseQuery = IncidentReport::whereBetween('incident_date', [$from, $to]);

        $total = (clone $baseQuery)->count();
        $majorCount = (clone $baseQuery)->where('severity', 'major')->count();
        $criticalCount = (clone $baseQuery)->where('severity', 'critical')->count();
        $minorCount = (clone $baseQuery)->where('severity', 'minor')->count();

        // Active = Anything not resolved, turned over, or overridden
        $activeCount = (clone $baseQuery)->whereNotIn('status', ['resolved', 'turned_over', 'overridden'])->count();

        // Count resolved and turned over cases as successfully closed by the school
        $closedCount = (clone $baseQuery)->whereIn('status', ['resolved', 'turned_over', 'overridden'])->count();

        $resolvedRate = $total === 0 ? 0 : round(($closedCount / $total) * 100);

        // Fetch recent escalated cases for quick view
        $escalatedCases = IncidentReport::with('student')
            ->where('status', 'escalated')
            ->latest('incident_date')
            ->take(5)
            ->get();

        // --- ADDED FOR THE TREND CHART ---
        // Generates Data for the Trend Chart (Grouped by Date)
        $trendData = (clone $baseQuery)
            ->selectRaw('DATE(incident_date) as date, COUNT(*) as count')
            ->groupBy('date')
            ->orderBy('date', 'asc')
            ->get();

        $chartDates = $trendData->pluck('date')->map(function($date) {
            return \Carbon\Carbon::parse($date)->format('M d'); // e.g., "Jul 01"
        })->toArray();

        $chartData = $trendData->pluck('count')->toArray();
        // ---------------------------------

        // We inject 'chartDates' and 'chartData' into the compact array so the blade can read it
        return view('school_head.behavioral_oversight.index', compact(
            'from', 'to', 'total', 'majorCount', 'criticalCount', 'minorCount', 'activeCount', 'resolvedRate', 'escalatedCases',
            'chartDates', 'chartData'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * 2. Master Case Logs
     */
    public function cases(Request $request): View
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'start_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'end_date'   => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'severity'   => ['nullable', 'in:minor,major,critical'],
            'status'     => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'q'          => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ]);

        $from = $validated['start_date'] ?? null;
        $to   = $validated['end_date'] ?? null;
        $severity = $validated['severity'] ?? null;
        $status = $validated['status'] ?? null;
        $q = trim($validated['q'] ?? '');

        $query = IncidentReport::with(['student', 'teacher']);

        if ($from && $to) {
            $query->whereBetween('incident_date', [$from, $to]);
        }
        if ($severity) $query->where('severity', $severity);
        if ($status) $query->where('status', $status);

        if ($q !== '') {
            $query->where(function ($sub) use ($q) {
                $sub->where('offense_type', 'like', "%{$q}%")
                    ->orWhere('narrative', 'like', "%{$q}%")
                    ->orWhereHas('student', function ($s) use ($q) {
                        $s->where('lrn', 'like', "%{$q}%")
                          ->orWhere('first_name', 'like', "%{$q}%")
                          ->orWhere('last_name', 'like', "%{$q}%");
                    });
            });
        }

        // Order by active/escalated first, then newest
        $incidents = $query
            ->orderByRaw("CASE WHEN status IN ('resolved', 'turned_over', 'overridden') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END")
            ->latest('incident_date')
            ->paginate(20)
            ->withQueryString();

        return view('school_head.behavioral_oversight.cases', compact(
            'incidents', 'from', 'to', 'severity', 'status', 'q'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Case Detail View
     */
    public function show(IncidentReport $incident): View
    {
        $incident->load(['student', 'teacher']);

        // Determine if Principal can intervene
        $canIntervene = in_array($incident->severity, ['major', 'critical']) || $incident->status === 'escalated';

        return view('school_head.behavioral_oversight.show', compact('incident', 'canIntervene'));
    }

    /**
     * Update Case (Principal Action - keeps case open)
     */
    public function update(Request $request, IncidentReport $incident)
    {
        abort_if($incident->severity === 'minor' && $incident->status !== 'escalated', 403, 'Cannot intervene in minor offenses.');

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'principal_action' => ['required', 'string'],
            'status'           => ['required', 'in:pending,in_intervention,resolved,escalated,turned_over,overridden'],
        ]);

        $incident->update([
            'principal_action' => $validated['principal_action'],
            'status'           => $validated['status'],
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('school_head.behavior.show', $incident->id)
                         ->with('success', 'Case notes updated successfully.');
    }

    /**
     * Quick Resolve (Principal signs off or acknowledges handover)
     */
    public function resolve(Request $request, IncidentReport $incident)
    {
        abort_if($incident->severity === 'minor' && $incident->status !== 'escalated', 403, 'Cannot resolve minor offenses directly.');

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'principal_action' => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ]);

        // If it was turned over, keep it turned over. Otherwise, mark it resolved.
        $newStatus = $incident->status === 'turned_over' ? 'turned_over' : 'resolved';

        $incident->update([
            'status'           => $newStatus,
            'principal_action' => $validated['principal_action'] ?? $incident->principal_action,
        ]);

        $message = $newStatus === 'turned_over' ? 'External handover officially acknowledged.' : 'Case marked as resolved.';

        return redirect()->route('school_head.behavior.show', $incident->id)
                         ->with('success', $message);
    }

    /**
     * Override Critical Good Moral Block
     */
    public function override(Request $request, IncidentReport $incident)
    {
        abort_if($incident->severity !== 'critical', 403, 'Only critical legal matters require an override.');

        $incident->update([
            'status' => 'overridden',
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('school_head.behavior.show', $incident->id)
                         ->with('success', 'Good Moral block successfully overridden. The student is now cleared.');
    }

    /**
     * 3. Good Moral Clearance Audits
     */
    public function goodMoral(): View
    {
        // 1. BLOCKED STUDENTS: Found in the behavioral DB (students table) with active major/critical cases
        $blockedStudents = Student::whereHas('incidentReports', function ($query) {
            $query->where(function ($q) {
                $q->where('severity', 'major')->whereNotIn('status', ['resolved', 'overridden']);
            })->orWhere(function ($q) {
                $q->where('severity', 'critical')->where('status', '!=', 'overridden');
            });
        })->with(['incidentReports' => function ($q) {
            $q->where(function ($sub) {
                $sub->where('severity', 'major')->whereNotIn('status', ['resolved', 'overridden']);
            })->orWhere(function ($sub) {
                $sub->where('severity', 'critical')->where('status', '!=', 'overridden');
            })->latest('incident_date');
        }])->get();

        // Extract the exact LRNs of the blocked students
        $blockedLrns = $blockedStudents->pluck('lrn')->toArray();

        // 2. ELIGIBLE STUDENTS: Everyone in the LIS Staging roster EXCEPT the blocked LRNs.
        // We paginate this because a school might have thousands of eligible students.
        $eligibleStudents = DB::table('lis_stagings')
            ->whereNotIn('lrn', $blockedLrns)
            ->orderBy('last_name')
            ->orderBy('first_name')
            ->paginate(15);

        return view('school_head.behavioral_oversight.good_moral', compact('blockedStudents', 'eligibleStudents'));
    }
}
