<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\SchoolHead;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\CotObservation;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class CotController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): View
    {
        $teachers = User::whereHas('roles', function ($query) {$query->where('name', 'teacher');
        })->orderBy('last_name')->get();

        $pendingRequests = CotObservation::with('teacher')
            ->where('status', 'pending')
            ->orderBy('created_at', 'asc')
            ->get();

        $masterTeachers = User::whereHas('roles', function ($query) {$query->where('name', 'teacher');
        })->where('deped_rank', 'LIKE', '%Master%')->get();

        return view('school_head.cot.index', compact('teachers', 'pendingRequests', 'masterTeachers'));
    }

    public function assignObserver(Request $request,$id): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate(['observer_id' => 'required|exists:users,id']);

        $observation = CotObservation::findOrFail($id);$observation->update([
            'observer_id' => $request->observer_id,
            'status' => 'scheduled'
        ]);

        return back()->with('status', 'Observer successfully assigned. Schedule approved.');
    }

    public function blankForm(Request $request): View
    {
        $tier =$request->query('tier', 'proficient');
        $indicators =$this->getDepEdIndicators();
        return view('school_head.cot.blank', compact('tier', 'indicators'));
    }

    public function create(User $teacher): View
    {
        $indicators =$this->getDepEdIndicators();
        return view('school_head.cot.create', compact('teacher', 'indicators'));
    }

    public function store(Request $request, User$teacher): RedirectResponse
    {
        $indicators =$this->getDepEdIndicators();
        $submittedScores =$request->input('scores', []);

        $processedScores = [];$totalScore = 0;
        $count = 0;

        foreach ($submittedScores as $num =>$score) {
            $processedScores[$num] = [
                'title' => $indicators[$num] ?? 'Indicator ' .$num,
                'score' => $score
            ];

            if (is_numeric($score)) {
                $totalScore +=$score;
                $count++;
            }
        }

        $averageRating =$count > 0 ? round($totalScore / $count, 2) : 0;

        $observation = CotObservation::create([
            'teacher_id' => $teacher->id,
            'observer_id' => Auth::id(),
            'status' => 'completed',
            'observation_date' => $request->input('observation_date', now()->format('Y-m-d')),
            'time_started' => $request->input('time_started', '00:00:00'),
            'time_ended' => $request->input('time_ended', '00:00:00'),             'section' =>$request->input('section', 'N/A'),
            'subject_taught' => $request->input('subject_taught'),
            'grade_level' => $request->input('grade_level'),
            'quarter' => $request->input('quarter'),
            'rating' => $averageRating,
            'comments' => $request->input('comments', 'No comments provided.'),
            'scores' => $processedScores
        ]);

        session()->forget('scanned_scores');

        return redirect()->route('school_head.cot.show', $observation->id)
                         ->with('status', 'Classroom Observation Rating saved successfully.');
    }

    public function show($id): View
    {
        $observation = CotObservation::with(['teacher', 'observer'])->findOrFail($id);
        return view('school_head.cot.show', compact('observation'));
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // UPGRADED: Gemini 2.5 Flash Vision Scanner
    // =========================================================================
    public function scan(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'cot_image' => 'required|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg|max:5120',
        ]);

        $imagePath =$request->file('cot_image')->store('temp_scans');
        $absolutePath = Storage::path($imagePath);

        if (!file_exists($absolutePath)) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Upload failed: Could not locate the image file.');
        }

        try {
            $apiKey = env('GEMINI_API_KEY');
            if (!$apiKey) {
                throw new \Exception("GEMINI_API_KEY is missing from your .env file.");
            }

            // Convert image to Base64 for the Gemini API
            $mimeType = mime_content_type($absolutePath);
            $base64Image = base64_encode(file_get_contents($absolutePath));

            $prompt = "You are an expert AI assistant tasked with extracting data from a Philippine DepEd Classroom Observation Tool (COT) rating sheet.
            Carefully read the handwritten text on this form.
            Extract the observed teacher's full name and the numerical scores (ranging from 2 to 8) for Indicators 1 through 9.
            Return ONLY a valid, raw JSON object without any markdown wrapping (do not use ```json).
            Format exactly like this:
            {
                \"teacher_name\": \"First Last\",
                \"scores\": {
                    \"1\": 5,
                    \"2\": 6,
                    \"3\": null,
                    \"4\": 7,
                    \"5\": 5,
                    \"6\": 6,
                    \"7\": 7,
                    \"8\": 8,
                    \"9\": 4
                }
            }
            If a score is missing, blank, or you cannot read it due to handwriting, set the value to null.";

            $baseUrl = "https://" . "generativelanguage.googleapis.com";
            $endpoint = "/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=";
            $apiUrl = $baseUrl . $endpoint . trim($apiKey);

            $response = Http::withOptions(['verify' => false])
                ->withHeaders(['Content-Type' => 'application/json'])
                ->timeout(60)
                ->post($apiUrl, [
                    'contents' => [
                        [
                            'parts' => [
                                ['text' => $prompt],
                                [
                                    'inlineData' => [
                                        'mimeType' => $mimeType,
                                        'data' => $base64Image
                                    ]
                                ]
                            ]
                        ]
                    ],
                    'generationConfig' => [
                        'temperature' => 0.1, // Low temperature for factual extraction
                        'responseMimeType' => 'application/json',
                    ]
                ]);

            // Clean up the temp file immediately after API call
            unlink($absolutePath);

            if (!$response->successful()) {
                throw new \Exception('Google API Error: ' . $response->body());
            }

            $result = $response->json();
            $aiText = $result['candidates'][0]['content']['parts'][0]['text'] ?? '{}';

            // Parse the JSON returned by Gemini
            $extractedData = json_decode(trim($aiText), true);

            if (!$extractedData || !isset($extractedData['scores'])) {
                 return back()->with('error', 'AI Scanner failed to return structured data. Please ensure the image is clear.');
            }

            // Map the JSON to our expected session array (strictly indicators 1-9)
            $scannedScores = [];
            $missingCount = 0;

            for ($i = 1; $i <= 9; $i++) {
                $score = $extractedData['scores'][(string)$i] ?? null;

                // Validate score constraints (2 to 8)
                if (is_numeric($score) && $score >= 2 && $score <= 8) {
                    $scannedScores[$i] = (int)$score;
                } else {
                    $scannedScores[$i] = '';
                    $missingCount++;
                }
            }

            session()->put('scanned_scores', $scannedScores);

            // --- TEACHER NAME DETECTION ---
            $matchedTeacher = null;
            $extractedName = strtolower(trim($extractedData['teacher_name'] ?? ''));

            if (!empty($extractedName)) {
                $teachers = User::whereHas('roles', function ($query) {
                    $query->where('name', 'teacher');
                })->get();

                $highestSimilarity = 0;

                foreach ($teachers as $teacher) {
                    $firstName = strtolower(trim($teacher->first_name));
                    $lastName = strtolower(trim($teacher->last_name));

                    // Compare both First Last and Last First formats
                    $format1 = $firstName . ' ' . $lastName;
                    $format2 = $lastName . ' ' . $firstName;

                    similar_text($extractedName, $format1, $percent1);
                    similar_text($extractedName, $format2, $percent2);

                    $maxPercent = max($percent1, $percent2);

                    // 75% threshold accounts for messy handwriting interpretations (e.g., "Jalani" vs "Jelani")
                    if ($maxPercent >= 75 && $maxPercent > $highestSimilarity) {
                        $highestSimilarity = $maxPercent;
                        $matchedTeacher = $teacher;
                    }
                }
            }

            $completenessMsg = $missingCount === 0
                ? "All 9 indicators were successfully extracted."
                : "Warning: {$missingCount} indicators require manual verification.";

            if ($matchedTeacher) {
                return redirect()->route('school_head.cot.create', $matchedTeacher->id)
                    ->with('status', "Form detected for {$matchedTeacher->first_name} {$matchedTeacher->last_name}. {$completenessMsg}");
            } else {
                return redirect()->route('school_head.cot.index')
                    ->with('show_teacher_modal', true)
                    ->with('error', "Scores extracted, but the AI could not definitively match the handwriting to a Teacher's name in the database. {$completenessMsg}");
            }

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('Gemini Scanner Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
            if (file_exists($absolutePath)) {
                unlink($absolutePath);
            }
            return back()->with('error', 'AI Scanner failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    private function getDepEdIndicators(): array
    {
        return [
            1 => 'Apply knowledge of content within and across curriculum teaching areas.',
            2 => 'Use a range of teaching strategies that enhance learner achievement in literacy and numeracy skills.',
            3 => 'Apply a range of teaching strategies to develop critical and creative thinking.',
            4 => 'Manage classroom structure to engage learners, individually or in groups.',
            5 => 'Manage learner behavior constructively by applying positive and non-violent discipline.',
            6 => 'Use differentiated, developmentally appropriate learning experiences.',
            7 => 'Plan, manage and implement developmentally sequenced teaching and learning processes.',
            8 => 'Select, develop, organize and use appropriate teaching and learning resources.',
            9 => 'Design, select, organize and use diagnostic, formative and summative assessment strategies.',
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\SchoolHead;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\DailyLessonLog;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class DllApprovalController extends Controller
{
    // 1. Dashboard Index with School Year Filter
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $activeSY = $request->get('sy', '2026-2027');
        [$startYear, $endYear] = explode('-', $activeSY);
        $syStartDate = $startYear . '-06-01 00:00:00';
        $syEndDate = $endYear . '-05-31 23:59:59';

        $groupedLogs = DailyLessonLog::with(['author', 'entries'])
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$syStartDate, $syEndDate])
            ->latest('submitted_at')
            ->get()
            ->groupBy(function ($log) {
                return $log->author ? $log->author->name : 'Unassigned Teacher';
            });

        return view('school_head.dll.index', compact('groupedLogs', 'activeSY'));
    }

    // 2. Mark as Checked (DepEd Compliant)
    public function markAsChecked(Request $request, DailyLessonLog $dll): RedirectResponse
    {
        $dll->update([
            'reviewer_id' => $request->user()->id,
            'status' => 'checked',
            'is_ai_passed' => true,
        ]);
        return back()->with('status', 'Lesson plan successfully marked as Checked.');
    }

    // 3. Return for Technical Assistance (DepEd Compliant)
    public function provideTechnicalAssistance(Request $request, DailyLessonLog $dll): RedirectResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'review_feedback' => ['required', 'string']
        ]);

        $dll->update([
            'reviewer_id' => $request->user()->id,
            'status' => 'needs_revision',
            'reflection_notes' => trim(($dll->reflection_notes ? $dll->reflection_notes."\n\n" : '').'🛡️ Technical Assistance from School Head: '.$data['review_feedback']),
        ]);
        return back()->with('status', 'Technical assistance sent to the teacher.');
    }

    // 4. Excel Download
    public function exportChecklist()
    {
        return \Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel::download(new \App\Exports\DllChecklistExport, 'Official_DLL_Checklist.xlsx');
    }

    // 5. Official Document Viewer
    public function show(DailyLessonLog $dll): View
    {
        $dll->load(['author', 'entries' => function ($query) {
            $query->orderBy('entry_date', 'asc');
        }]);
        return view('school_head.dll.show', compact('dll'));
    }

    public function generateAiBrief(Request $request, DailyLessonLog $dll)
    {
        try {
            $dll->load('entries');

            $lessonContext = "Subject: {$dll->subject}\nGrade: {$dll->grade_quarter}\nDates: {$dll->teaching_dates}\n\n";

            $hasContent = false;
            foreach ($dll->entries as $entry) {
                if ($entry->procedure_a || $entry->procedure_b || $entry->procedure_c || $entry->procedure_e) {
                    $hasContent = true;
                    $lessonContext .= "--- Date: {$entry->entry_date} ---\n";
                    $lessonContext .= "Goal/Intentions: {$entry->procedure_a} {$entry->procedure_b}\n";
                    $lessonContext .= "Activities: {$entry->procedure_c}\n";
                    $lessonContext .= "Assessment: {$entry->procedure_e}\n\n";
                }
            }

            if (!$hasContent) {
                 return response()->json([
                    'brief' => 'The lesson matrix appears to be empty. No analysis can be performed.',
                    'suggested_feedback' => 'Please complete your daily matrix before submitting.'
                ]);
            }

            $prompt = "You are an expert DepEd School Head / Educational Supervisor reviewing a teacher's Weekly Lesson Log.
            Analyze the following lesson plan.

            Return ONLY a raw JSON object (no markdown wrapping, no ```json). Follow this exact structure:
            {
                \"brief\": \"A 3-4 sentence professional summary evaluating the overall pedagogical quality, alignment of activities to goals, and DepEd compliance.\",
                \"suggested_feedback\": \"A specific, constructive 1-2 sentence note offering 'Technical Assistance' to the teacher. If the plan is perfect, offer a word of professional encouragement.\"
            }

            Lesson Plan Data to analyze:
            " . $lessonContext;

            $apiKey = env('GEMINI_API_KEY');

            if (!$apiKey) {
                throw new \Exception("The GEMINI_API_KEY is missing in the .env file.");
            }

            // EDITOR-PROOF URL & UPGRADED 2026 MODEL (gemini-2.5-flash)
            $baseUrl = "https://" . "generativelanguage.googleapis.com";
            $endpoint = "/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=";
            $apiUrl = $baseUrl . $endpoint . trim($apiKey);

            $response = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http::withOptions([
                'verify' => false,
            ])->withHeaders([
                'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            ])->timeout(60)->post($apiUrl, [
                'contents' => [
                    ['parts' => [['text' => $prompt]]]
                ],
                'generationConfig' => [
                    'temperature' => 0.2,
                    'responseMimeType' => 'application/json',
                ]
            ]);

            if (!$response->successful()) {
                throw new \Exception('Google API Error: ' . $response->body());
            }

            $result = $response->json();
            $aiText = $result['candidates'][0]['content']['parts'][0]['text'] ?? '{}';

            return response()->json(json_decode(trim($aiText), true));

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::error('School Head AI Error: ' . $e->getMessage());

            return response()->json([
                'brief' => '⚠️ System Error: ' . $e->getMessage(),
                'suggested_feedback' => 'Please review document manually.'
            ]);
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/Http/Controllers/SchoolHead/DssAnalyticsController.php

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\SchoolHead;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\DailyLessonLog;
use App\Models\IncidentReport;
use App\Models\Inventory;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class DssAnalyticsController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        // 1. School Year Filter
        $activeSY = $request->get('sy', '2026-2027');
        [$startYear, $endYear] = explode('-', $activeSY);
        $syStartDate = $startYear . '-06-01 00:00:00';
        $syEndDate = $endYear . '-05-31 23:59:59';

        // =========================================================================
        // DATA GATHERING: FACULTY COMPLIANCE
        // =========================================================================
        $groupedLogs = DailyLessonLog::with('author')
            ->whereBetween('created_at', [$syStartDate, $syEndDate])
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('author_id');

        $facultyRankings = collect();
        $totalLogsSystemWide = 0;
        $totalReturnedSystemWide = 0;

        foreach($groupedLogs as $authorId => $logs) {
            $authorName = $logs->first()->author->name ?? 'Unknown Teacher';
            $total = $logs->count();
            $checked = $logs->where('status', 'checked')->count();
            $needsRevision = $logs->where('status', 'needs_revision')->count();

            $totalLogsSystemWide += $total;
            $totalReturnedSystemWide += $needsRevision;

            $complianceRate = $total > 0 ? round(($checked / $total) * 100) : 0;

            $facultyRankings->push((object)[
                'name' => $authorName,
                'total' => $total,
                'checked' => $checked,
                'needs_revision' => $needsRevision,
                'compliance_rate' => $complianceRate
            ]);
        }

        // Sort Highest to Lowest for the Leaderboard
        $facultyRankings = $facultyRankings->sortByDesc('compliance_rate')->values();

        // =========================================================================
        // DATA GATHERING: BEHAVIORAL VIOLATIONS
        // =========================================================================
        $incidents = IncidentReport::whereBetween('incident_date', [$syStartDate, $syEndDate])->get();

        $majorIncidentsCount = $incidents->where('severity', 'major')->count();
        $topOffense = $incidents->groupBy('offense_type')->map->count()->sortDesc()->keys()->first() ?? 'None recorded';

        // =========================================================================
        // DATA GATHERING: ASSETS & INVENTORY
        // =========================================================================
        $inventories = Inventory::withCount('transactions')->get();

        $itemsNearingDepreciation = 0;
        $urgentProcurementCount = 0;

        foreach($inventories as $item) {
            $isExpired = $item->expiry_date && Carbon::parse($item->expiry_date)->isPast();
            $isDamaged = in_array(strtolower($item->condition), ['damaged', 'poor', 'condemned']);

            if ($isExpired || $isDamaged || $item->transactions_count >= 5) {
                $itemsNearingDepreciation++;
            }
            if ($item->quantity <= $item->reorder_level) {
                $urgentProcurementCount++;
            }
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // AI GENERATION: EXECUTIVE SUMMARIES (Gemini 2.5 Flash)
        // =========================================================================
        $aiFacultySummary = 'Gathering compliance data to generate technical assistance recommendations...';
        $aiBehaviorSummary = 'Processing violation records to map behavioral hotspots and recommend security deployments...';
        $aiAssetSummary = 'Analyzing asset acquisition dates and repair logs to determine upcoming condemnation and procurement requirements...';

        try {
            $apiKey = env('GEMINI_API_KEY');
            if ($apiKey) {
                $prompt = "You are an AI Decision Support System for a School Principal. Analyze the following school data and provide three short, professional executive summaries (maximum 2 sentences each). Focus on actionable administrative advice.

                DATA:
                - Faculty: {$totalLogsSystemWide} total lesson logs submitted. {$totalReturnedSystemWide} returned for revision.
                - Behavior: {$majorIncidentsCount} major violation records. Top offense type is '{$topOffense}'. (Note: Do not mention absenteeism).
                - Assets: {$itemsNearingDepreciation} items flagged for life-cycle condemnation. {$urgentProcurementCount} categories need urgent reordering.

                Output strictly in valid JSON format like this:
                {
                    \"faculty\": \"...\",
                    \"behavior\": \"...\",
                    \"asset\": \"...\"
                }";

                $baseUrl = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com";
                $endpoint = "/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=";

                $response = Http::withOptions(['verify' => false])
                    ->withHeaders(['Content-Type' => 'application/json'])
                    ->timeout(15)
                    ->post($baseUrl . $endpoint . trim($apiKey), [
                        'contents' => [['parts' => [['text' => $prompt]]]],
                        'generationConfig' => ['temperature' => 0.2]
                    ]);

                if ($response->successful()) {
                    $result = $response->json();
                    $aiText = $result['candidates'][0]['content']['parts'][0]['text'] ?? '';

                    // Clean markdown formatting if Gemini returns it
                    $aiText = str_replace(['```json', '```'], '', $aiText);
                    $parsedJson = json_decode(trim($aiText), true);

                    if (json_last_error() === JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
                        $aiFacultySummary = $parsedJson['faculty'] ?? $aiFacultySummary;
                        $aiBehaviorSummary = $parsedJson['behavior'] ?? $aiBehaviorSummary;
                        $aiAssetSummary = $parsedJson['asset'] ?? $aiAssetSummary;
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('DSS AI Generation Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
            // It will gracefully fall back to the default text strings if the API fails
        }

        // =========================================================================
        // RETURN TO VIEW
        // =========================================================================
        return view('school_head.dss.index', compact(
            'activeSY',
            'facultyRankings',
            'aiFacultySummary',
            'aiBehaviorSummary',
            'aiAssetSummary'
        ));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\SchoolHead;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Inventory;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class SchoolheadInventoryController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the Executive Asset Oversight Dashboard.
     */
    public function index()
    {
        // 1. Total Asset Volume
        $totalAssets = Inventory::count();

        // 2. Infrastructure Health Index Calculations
        $serviceableCount = Inventory::where('condition', 'Serviceable')->count();
        $repairCount = Inventory::whereIn('condition', ['Needs Minor Repair', 'Needs Major Repair'])->count();
        $unserviceableCount = Inventory::where('condition', 'Unserviceable')->count();

        // Calculate percentages safely (avoiding division by zero)
        $healthPercentage = $totalAssets > 0 ? round(($serviceableCount / $totalAssets) * 100) : 0;
        $repairPercentage = $totalAssets > 0 ? round(($repairCount / $totalAssets) * 100) : 0;
        $unserviceablePercentage = $totalAssets > 0 ? round(($unserviceableCount / $totalAssets) * 100) : 0;

        // 3. Accountability Flags
        $missingCount = Inventory::where('condition', 'Missing')->count();

        // 4. Pending Condemnation & Disposal Queue
        // Fetch all non-expendable/semi-expendable items that the Admin marked as Unserviceable
        $pendingDisposals = Inventory::where('condition', 'Unserviceable')
            ->whereIn('lifespan_type', ['Non-Expendable', 'Semi-Expendable'])
            ->latest()
            ->get();

        // 5. Supply Burn Rate Insights
        // Fetch Consumables that have dropped below their reorder threshold
        $highConsumptionItems = Inventory::where('lifespan_type', 'Consumable')
            ->whereNotNull('reorder_level')
            ->whereColumn('quantity', '<=', 'reorder_level')
            ->orderBy('quantity', 'asc')
            ->take(6) // Limit to top 6 most critical items for the UI card
            ->get();

        return view('school_head.inventory.index', compact(
            'totalAssets',
            'healthPercentage',
            'repairPercentage',
            'unserviceablePercentage',
            'missingCount',
            'pendingDisposals',
            'highConsumptionItems'
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Approve the write-off/disposal of a condemned asset.
     */
    public function approveDisposal(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $asset = Inventory::findOrFail($id);

        // Ensure only unserviceable items are disposed
        if ($asset->condition !== 'Unserviceable') {
            return back()->with('error', 'Only unserviceable items can be written off.');
        }

        // Action: In a real scenario, you might change status to 'Disposed'
        // or utilize SoftDeletes to remove it from active inventory but keep the record.
        $asset->delete(); // Assuming SoftDeletes is on the Inventory model

        // Log the executive action in the transactions table
        $asset->transactions()->create([
            'user_id' => auth()->id(), // School Head
            'action_type' => 'Condition Change',
            'quantity' => $asset->quantity,
            'status' => 'Completed',
            'notes' => 'Executive Approval: Asset officially condemned and written off the registry.'
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Asset successfully approved for disposal and removed from active registry.');
    }

    /**
     * Reject the disposal request (e.g., mandate a repair attempt instead).
     */
    public function rejectDisposal(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $asset = Inventory::findOrFail($id);

        // Revert condition so the Admin has to coordinate repairs
        $asset->update([
            'condition' => 'Needs Major Repair'
        ]);

        $asset->transactions()->create([
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'action_type' => 'Condition Change',
            'quantity' => $asset->quantity,
            'status' => 'Completed',
            'notes' => 'Executive Rejection: Disposal denied. Flagged for mandatory repair attempt.'
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Disposal rejected. The asset has been flagged for repair.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Teacher;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

class AiAssistantController extends Controller
{
    public function generateSuggestion(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'subject' => 'required|string',
            'intentions' => 'required|string',
            'type' => 'required|in:learning_experience,assessment'
        ]);

        $subject = $request->subject;
        $intentions = $request->intentions;
        $type = $request->type;

        // Build the prompt specifically for DepEd context
        if ($type === 'learning_experience') {
            $prompt = "You are a master DepEd teacher in the Philippines. Based on this lesson intention/goal: '$intentions' for the subject '$subject', suggest a brief, highly engaging classroom activity (Learning Experience) that takes 15-20 minutes. Keep it practical, requiring minimal materials. Output ONLY the activity description in plain text. Do not use markdown bolding, asterisks, or pleasantries.";
        } else {
            $prompt = "You are a master DepEd teacher in the Philippines. Based on this lesson intention/goal: '$intentions' for the subject '$subject', suggest a quick, effective formative assessment (e.g., 3-question quiz, short seatwork, or exit ticket) to check if the students understood the lesson. Output ONLY the assessment in plain text. Do not use markdown bolding, asterisks, or pleasantries.";
        }

        try {
            // Google Gemini API Endpoint
            $apiKey = config('services.gemini.key');
            $url = 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent?key=' . $apiKey;

            // ADDED ->withoutVerifying() HERE FOR LOCAL TESTING
            $response = Http::withoutVerifying()->timeout(15)->post($url, [
                'contents' => [
                    [
                        'parts' => [
                            ['text' => $prompt]
                        ]
                    ]
                ],
                'generationConfig' => [
                    'temperature' => 0.7,
                ]
            ]);

            if ($response->successful()) {
                $suggestion = $response->json('candidates.0.content.parts.0.text');
                return response()->json(['suggestion' => trim($suggestion)]);
            }

            return response()->json(['error' => 'Google Gemini API Error'], 500);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            // It helps to log the real error behind the scenes!
            \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::error('AI Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Connection timeout or formatting error.'], 500);
        }
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Teacher;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\CotObservation;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class CotController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $teacher = Auth::user();

        // Fetch all their observations from the database, ordered by newest first
        $observations = CotObservation::where('teacher_id', $teacher->id)
            ->with('observer')
            ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
            ->get();

        // Split them into two groups for the two tables on your dashboard
        $activeRequests = $observations->whereIn('status', ['pending', 'scheduled']);
        $completedObservations = $observations->where('status', 'completed');

        // Pass all variables to the view
        return view('teacher.cot.index', compact('teacher', 'activeRequests', 'completedObservations'));
    }

    public function storeRequest(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'observation_date' => 'required|date|after_or_equal:today',
            'time_started' => 'required',
            'time_ended' => 'required|after:time_started',
            'subject_taught' => 'required|string',
            'grade_level' => 'required|string',
            'section' => 'required|string',
            'quarter' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:4',
        ]);

        // Save the request to the database
        CotObservation::create([
            'teacher_id' => Auth::id(),
            'status' => 'pending', // Starts as pending until School Head approves
            'observation_date' => $request->observation_date,
            'time_started' => $request->time_started,
            'time_ended' => $request->time_ended,
            'subject_taught' => $request->subject_taught,
            'grade_level' => $request->grade_level,
            'section' => $request->section,
            'quarter' => $request->quarter,
        ]);

        return back()->with('status', 'Observation request submitted successfully. Waiting for School Head approval.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Teacher;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\DailyLessonLog;
use App\Models\TeachingLoad;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use App\Exports\DllTemplateExport;

class DailyLessonLogController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $profiles = TeachingLoad::query()
            ->where('teacher_id', $request->user()->id)
            ->orderBy('subject')
            ->orderBy('grade_level')
            ->get();

        $query =$request->user()->authoredDailyLessonLogs();

        if ($request->filled('status')) {
            $query->where('status',$request->status);
        }

        $dailyLessonLogs =$query
            ->orderByDesc('updated_at')
            ->paginate(15)
            ->withQueryString();

        return view('teacher.dll.index', compact('profiles', 'dailyLessonLogs'));
    }

    public function downloadExcelTemplate(Request $request)
    {
        $data =$request->validate([
            'school_name' => 'required|string',
            'subject' => 'required|string',
            'grade_level' => 'required|string',
            'framework' => 'required|in:ILAW,MATATAG',
        ]);

        $fileName = 'TrackEd_Draft_' . $data['subject'] . '_' .$data['framework'] . '.xlsx';

        return Excel::download(new DllTemplateExport($data),$fileName);
    }

    public function uploadExcelDraft(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'excel_file' => 'required|mimes:xlsx,xls|max:5120',
        ]);

        try {
            // Load the first sheet as a raw array
            $rawArray = Excel::toArray(new \stdClass(),$request->file('excel_file'))[0];

            // Map the Excel cells to our database expected format
            // Based on the strict rows we defined in DllTemplateExport
            $framework =$rawArray[6][3] ?? 'ILAW';

            $payload = [
                'action' => 'draft',
                'template_type' => $framework,
                'subject' => $rawArray[7][1] ?? 'Unknown',
                'grade_quarter' => $rawArray[7][3] ?? 'Unknown',
                'week_start_date' => $rawArray[8][1] ?? now()->startOfWeek()->toDateString(),
                'week_end_date' => $rawArray[8][3] ?? now()->endOfWeek()->toDateString(),

                'content_standard' => $rawArray[10][1] ?? '',
                'performance_standard' => $rawArray[11][1] ?? '',
                'competencies' => $rawArray[12][1] ?? '',
                'references' => $rawArray[13][1] ?? '',

                'entries' => []
            ];

            // Rows 16 to 20 contain Monday to Friday (Index 16 to 20 in 0-based array)
            for ($i = 16; $i <= 20; $i++) {
                if (!isset($rawArray[$i])) continue;

                // Calculate date based on week start
                $date = \Carbon\Carbon::parse($payload['week_start_date'])->addDays($i - 16)->toDateString();

                $payload['entries'][] = [
                    'entry_date' => $date,
                    'procedure_a' => $rawArray[$i][1] ?? null,
                    'procedure_c' => $rawArray[$i][2] ?? null,
                    'procedure_e' => $rawArray[$i][3] ?? null,
                    'reflection' => $rawArray[$i][4] ?? null,
                ];
            }

            // Create a fake request to reuse your existing import logic
            $fakeRequest = new Request($payload);
            $fakeRequest->setUserResolver(function () use ($request) {
                return $request->user();
            });

            return $this->importOffline($fakeRequest);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {             \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::error('Excel Upload Error: ' .$e->getMessage());
            return back()->withErrors(['excel_error' => 'Failed to extract data. Make sure you used the exact template and did not delete any instruction rows.']);
        }
    }

    public function resubmit(\Illuminate\Http\Request $request, \App\Models\DailyLessonLog$dll)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'teacher_remarks' => 'nullable|string'
        ]);

        $updatedNotes =$dll->reflection_notes;
        if ($request->filled('teacher_remarks')) {
            $updatedNotes .= "\n\n👩‍🏫 Teacher's Reply: " . $request->teacher_remarks;
        }

        $dll->update([
            'status' => 'submitted',
            'reflection_notes' => $updatedNotes,
            'submitted_at' => now(),
        ]);

        return back()->with('status', 'Your revised lesson plan has been resubmitted to the School Head.');
    }

    {
        $dll->update([
            'status' => 'submitted',
            'submitted_at' => now(),
        ]);

        return back()->with('status', 'Lesson Log successfully submitted to your School Head for review!');
    }

    public function week(Request $request, DailyLessonLog$dll): View
    {
        abort_unless($dll->author_id ===$request->user()->id, 403);

        $entries =$dll->entries()->orderBy('entry_date')->get()->keyBy(fn($e) =>$e->entry_date->toDateString());

        $weekDays = [];
        if ($dll->week_start_date) {
            for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {$weekDays[] = $dll->week_start_date->copy()->addDays($i)->toDateString();
            }
        }

        return view('teacher.dll.week', compact('dll', 'entries', 'weekDays'));
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // THE NEW PRE-FLIGHT COMPLIANCE SCANNER (LIVE AI CONNECTION)
    // =========================================================================
    public function scanCompliance(Request $request, DailyLessonLog$dll)
    {
        $data =$request->validate([
            'lesson_context' => 'required|string',
            'previous_feedback' => 'nullable|string'
        ]);

        $lessonContext =$data['lesson_context'];
        $previousFeedback =$data['previous_feedback'] ?? 'No previous feedback provided.';

        $prompt = "You are a strict, expert DepEd Master Teacher conducting a Pre-Flight Compliance Check on a Weekly Lesson Log.
        Analyze the submitted week-long lesson plan.

        Your evaluation MUST check for:
        1. Constructive Alignment: Do the 'Assessments/Evaluations' directly measure the stated 'Intentions/Goals' for each day?
        2. Pedagogical Soundness: Are the learning experiences engaging and logically sequenced?
        3. School Head Revisions: Did the teacher specifically address this previous feedback from their principal: '{$previousFeedback}'?

        You MUST return ONLY a raw JSON object with NO markdown wrapping (do not use ```json). Follow this exact structure:
        {
            \"revisions_addressed\": true,
            \"revision_feedback\": \"A specific sentence explaining if they fixed the principal's issue or missed it.\",
            \"alignment_feedback\": \"A strict evaluation of how well their daily activities and assessments align with their goals.\",
            \"action_items\": [\"Specific tweak 1\", \"Specific tweak 2\"]
        }

        Here is the Weekly Lesson Plan to analyze:
        " . $lessonContext;

        try {
            $apiKey = env('GEMINI_API_KEY');

            if (!$apiKey) {
                throw new \Exception("The GEMINI_API_KEY is completely missing or empty in Laravel's memory.");
            }

            // EDITOR-PROOF URL & UPGRADED 2026 MODEL (gemini-2.5-flash)
            $baseUrl = "https://" . "generativelanguage.googleapis.com";
            $endpoint = "/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=";
            $apiUrl = $baseUrl . $endpoint . trim($apiKey);

            $response = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http::withOptions([
                'verify' => false,
            ])->withHeaders([
                'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            ])->timeout(60)->post($apiUrl, [
                'contents' => [
                    ['parts' => [['text' => $prompt]]]
                ],
                'generationConfig' => [
                    'temperature' => 0.2,
                    'responseMimeType' => 'application/json',
                ]
            ]);

            if (!$response->successful()) {
                throw new \Exception('Google API Error: ' . $response->body());
            }

            $result = $response->json();
            $aiText = $result['candidates'][0]['content']['parts'][0]['text'] ?? '{}';

            return response()->json(json_decode(trim($aiText), true));

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::error('Pre-Flight Scanner Error: ' . $e->getMessage());

            return response()->json([
                "revisions_addressed" => false,
                "revision_feedback" => "Error details below:",
                "alignment_feedback" => $e->getMessage(),
                "action_items" => ["Read the error message above to identify the exact problem."]
            ]);
        }
    }

    public function importOffline(Request $request): RedirectResponse|JsonResponse
    {
        try {
            $data = $request->all();

            $combinedContentStandard = trim('Content Standard: ' . ($data['content_standard'] ?? '') . "\nPerformance Standard: " . ($data['performance_standard'] ?? ''));
            $combinedCompetencies = trim('Competencies: ' . ($data['competencies'] ?? '') . "\nObjectives: " . ($data['objectives'] ?? '') . "\nContent Topic: " . ($data['content'] ?? '') . "\nIntegration: " . ($data['integration'] ?? ''));
            $combinedResources = trim('References: ' . ($data['references'] ?? '') . "\nOther Materials: " . ($data['other_resources'] ?? ''));

            $weekStart = $data['week_start_date'] ?? now()->startOfWeek()->toDateString();
            $weekEnd = $data['week_end_date'] ?? now()->endOfWeek()->toDateString();

            $action = $data['action'] ?? 'draft';
            $status = $action === 'submit' ? 'pending' : 'draft';
            $submittedAt = $action === 'submit' ? now() : null;

            $dll = DailyLessonLog::query()->updateOrCreate(
                [
                    'author_id' => $request->user()->id,
                    'week_start_date' => $weekStart,
                ],
                [
                    'reviewer_id' => null,
                    'subject' => $data['subject'] ?? 'Untitled Subject',
                    'grade_quarter' => $data['grade_quarter'] ?? 'Unknown Grade',
                    'teaching_dates' => $weekStart . ' to ' . $weekEnd,
                    'week_end_date' => $weekEnd,
                    'content_standard' => $combinedContentStandard ?: 'Not Specified',
                    'competencies' => $combinedCompetencies ?: 'Not Specified',
                    'resources' => $combinedResources ?: 'Not Specified',
                    'procedure_a' => 'Moved to Daily Matrix',
                    'procedure_b' => 'Moved to Daily Matrix',
                    'procedure_c' => 'Moved to Daily Matrix',
                    'procedure_d' => 'Moved to Daily Matrix',
                    'procedure_e' => 'Moved to Daily Matrix',
                    'passed_count' => $data['passed_count'] ?? null,
                    'remedial_count' => $data['remedial_count'] ?? null,
                    'reflection_notes' => $data['reflection_notes'] ?? null,
                    'status' => $status,
                    'submitted_at' => $submittedAt,
                ]
            );

            foreach (($data['entries'] ?? []) as $e) {
                if (empty($e['entry_date']))
                    continue;

                $combinedReflection = null;
                if (!empty($e['remarks']) || !empty($e['reflection'])) {
                    $combinedReflection = trim('Remarks: ' . ($e['remarks'] ?? '') . "\nReflection: " . ($e['reflection'] ?? ''));
                }

                $dll->entries()->updateOrCreate(
                    ['entry_date' => $e['entry_date']],
                    [
                        'procedure_a' => $e['procedure_a'] ?? null,
                        'procedure_b' => $e['procedure_b'] ?? null,
                        'procedure_c' => $e['procedure_c'] ?? null,
                        'procedure_d' => $e['procedure_d'] ?? null,
                        'procedure_e' => $e['procedure_e'] ?? null,
                        'resources' => $e['resources'] ?? null,
                        'reflection_notes' => $combinedReflection,
                    ]
                );
            }

            if ($request->expectsJson()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'message' => 'Weekly DLL Draft Compiled Successfully.',
                    'dll_id' => $dll->id,
                ]);
            }

            return redirect()->route('teacher.dll.index')->with('success', 'MATATAG Weekly Log compiled successfully.');
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('DLL Compile Error: ' . $e->getMessage());

            if ($request->expectsJson()) {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage()], 500);
            }

            return back()->withErrors(['db_error' => 'Database Error: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
        }
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Teacher;

use App\Http\Requests\Teacher\StoreIncidentRequest;

use App\Models\Student;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class IncidentController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $incidentReports = $request->user()->incidentReports()->with('student')->latest('incident_date')->get();

        return view('teacher.incidents.index', compact('incidentReports'));
    }

    public function create(): View
    {
        return view('teacher.incidents.create');
    }

    public function store(StoreIncidentRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $student = Student::updateOrCreate([
            'lrn' => $request->string('student_lrn')->toString(),
        ], [
            'first_name' => $request->input('student_first_name'),
            'last_name' => $request->input('student_last_name'),
            'grade_level' => $request->input('grade_level'),
            'section' => $request->input('section'),

        IncidentReport::create([
            'teacher_id' => $request->user()->id,
            'student_id' => $student->id,
            'incident_date' => $request->date('incident_date'),
            'severity' => $request->string('severity')->toString(),
            'offense_type' => $request->string('offense_type')->toString(),
            'narrative' => $request->string('narrative')->toString(),
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('teacher.incidents.index')->with('status', 'Incident report submitted to the Guidance Office.');

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Teacher;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use App\Models\LisStaging;
use App\Models\Student;
use App\Models\IncidentReport;

class IncidentManagerController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        // 🔒 STRICT CONFIDENTIALITY FILTER:
        // Fetch reports ONLY submitted by this logged-in teacher
        $submittedReports = IncidentReport::with('student')
            ->where('teacher_id', Auth::id()) // <--- THIS IS THE SECURE LOCK
            ->latest('created_at')
            ->get();

        return view('teacher.behavior.index', compact('submittedReports'));
    }
    // Add these methods below your existing store() method

    public function edit(IncidentReport $incident)
    {
        // 🔒 SECURITY CHECK: Only allow editing if it belongs to the teacher AND is still pending
        if ($incident->teacher_id !== Auth::id() || $incident->status !== 'pending') {
            abort(403, 'You can only edit pending reports that you submitted.');
        }

        // We load the student relationship so we can display their name in the form
        $incident->load('student');

        return view('teacher.behavior.edit', compact('incident'));
    }

    public function update(Request $request, IncidentReport $incident)
    {
        // 🔒 SECURITY CHECK
        if ($incident->teacher_id !== Auth::id() || $incident->status !== 'pending') {
            abort(403, 'You can only edit pending reports that you submitted.');
        }

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'offense_type'  => 'required|string|not_in:Absent,Tardy,Cutting Classes',
            'severity'      => 'required|in:minor,major,critical',
            'narrative'     => 'required|string|min:10',
            'incident_date' => 'required|date',
        ]);

        $incident->update([
            'offense_type'  => $validated['offense_type'],
            'severity'      => $validated['severity'],
            'narrative'     => $validated['narrative'],
            'incident_date' => $validated['incident_date'],
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('teacher.behavior.index')
                         ->with('success', 'Incident report successfully updated.');
    }

    public function destroy(IncidentReport $incident)
    {
        // 🔒 SECURITY CHECK
        if ($incident->teacher_id !== Auth::id() || $incident->status !== 'pending') {
            abort(403, 'You can only delete pending reports that you submitted.');
        }

        $incident->delete();

        return redirect()->route('teacher.behavior.index')
                         ->with('success', 'Incident report permanently retracted.');
    }

    public function create()
    {
        $enrolledStudents = LisStaging::select('id', 'lrn', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'grade_level', 'section')
            ->orderBy('last_name')
            ->orderBy('first_name')
            ->get();

        return view('teacher.behavior.create', compact('enrolledStudents'));
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        // 1. Validate the array of students AND the new evidence photo
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'student_ids'    => 'required|array|min:1',
            'student_ids.*'  => 'exists:lis_stagings,id',
            'offense_type'   => 'required|string|not_in:Absent,Tardy,Cutting Classes',
            'severity'       => 'required|in:minor,major,critical',
            'narrative'      => 'required|string|min:10',
            'incident_date'  => 'required|date',
            // NEW: Secure image validation (max 2MB)
            'evidence_photo' => 'nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,png,jpg,gif|max:2048',
        ]);

        // 2. Handle the Photo Upload (If the teacher attached one)
        $evidencePath = null;
        if ($request->hasFile('evidence_photo')) {
            $evidencePath = $request->file('evidence_photo')->store('incident_evidence', 'public');
        }

        // 3. Loop through EVERY student selected
        foreach ($validated['student_ids'] as $stagedId) {

            $lisStudent = LisStaging::findOrFail($stagedId);

            $student = Student::firstOrCreate(
                ['lrn' => $lisStudent->lrn],
                [
                    'first_name'  => $lisStudent->first_name,
                    'last_name'   => $lisStudent->last_name,
                    'middle_name' => $lisStudent->middle_name ?? null,
                    'grade_level' => $lisStudent->grade_level,
                    'section'     => $lisStudent->section,
                ]
            );

            IncidentReport::create([
                'student_id'    => $student->id,
                'teacher_id'    => Auth::id(),
                'offense_type'  => $validated['offense_type'],
                'severity'      => $validated['severity'],
                'narrative'     => count($validated['student_ids']) > 1
                                     ? "[GROUP INCIDENT] " . $validated['narrative']
                                     : $validated['narrative'],
                'incident_date' => $validated['incident_date'],
                'evidence_path' => $evidencePath, // <-- SAVES THE PHOTO
                'status'        => 'pending',
            ]);
        }

        return redirect()->route('teacher.behavior.index')
                         ->with('success', 'Incident securely logged with evidence and escalated to the Counselor.');
    }
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Teacher;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\Teacher\StoreProfessionalGrowthRequest;
use App\Models\CotRating;
use App\Models\ProfessionalGrowth;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class PerformanceController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $growthEntries = $user->professionalGrowthEntries()->latest('date_attended')->get();
        $cotRatings = $user->cotRatings()->latest('rating_date')->get();
        $approvedDllCount = $user->authoredDailyLessonLogs()->where('status', 'approved')->count();
        $totalDllCount = max(1, $user->authoredDailyLessonLogs()->count());

        $stats = [
            'dll_compliance_rate' => round(($approvedDllCount / $totalDllCount) * 100),
            'average_cot_score' => round((float) $cotRatings->avg('score'), 2),
            'professional_growth_points' => round((float) $growthEntries->sum('points'), 2),
        ];

        return view('teacher.performance.index', compact('growthEntries', 'cotRatings', 'stats'));
    }

    public function createSeminar(): View
    {
        return view('teacher.performance.upload_seminar');
    }

    public function storeSeminar(StoreProfessionalGrowthRequest $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $path = $request->file('certificate_file')?->store('professional-growth', 'local');

        ProfessionalGrowth::create([
            'teacher_id' => $request->user()->id,
            'title' => $request->string('title')->toString(),
            'date_attended' => $request->date('date_attended'),
            'points' => $request->input('points'),
            'certificate_path' => $path,
            'verification_status' => 'pending',
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('teacher.performance.index')->with('status', 'Professional growth record submitted for verification.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Teacher;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\PortfolioItem;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;

class PortfolioController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the teacher's portfolio dashboard.
     */
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        // Fetch only the logged-in teacher's achievements, newest first
        $achievements = PortfolioItem::where('user_id', Auth::id())
            ->orderBy('date_earned', 'desc')
            ->get();

        return view('teacher.portfolio.index', compact('achievements'));
    }

    /**
     * Show the form for creating a new portfolio item.
     */
    public function create(): View
    {
        return view('teacher.portfolio.create');
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created portfolio item in the database.
     */
    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'title' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'category' => 'required|string|max:100',
            'level' => 'required|string|max:100',
            'date_earned' => 'required|date|before_or_equal:today',
            'description' => 'required|string|max:1000',
            'certificate_file' => 'required|file|mimes:pdf,jpg,jpeg,png|max:5120', // 5MB limit
        ]);

        // Handle the file upload securely
        $filePath = null;
        if ($request->hasFile('certificate_file')) {
            // Save it in the 'public/portfolio_vault' folder
            $filePath = $request->file('certificate_file')->store('portfolio_vault', 'public');
        }

        // Create the database record
        PortfolioItem::create([
            'user_id' => Auth::id(),
            'title' => $request->title,
            'category' => $request->category,
            'level' => $request->level,
            'date_earned' => $request->date_earned,
            'description' => $request->description,
            'file_path' => $filePath,
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('teacher.portfolio.index')
                         ->with('status', 'Achievement successfully added to your vault!');
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified portfolio item and its file from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(PortfolioItem $portfolio): RedirectResponse
    {
        // Security Check: Ensure the teacher only deletes their own records
        if ($portfolio->user_id !== Auth::id()) {
            abort(403, 'Unauthorized action.');
        }

        // Delete the physical file from the hard drive to save space
        if ($portfolio->file_path && Storage::disk('public')->exists($portfolio->file_path)) {
            Storage::disk('public')->delete($portfolio->file_path);
        }

        // Delete the database record
        $portfolio->delete();

        return redirect()->route('teacher.portfolio.index')
                         ->with('status', 'Achievement record permanently deleted.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Teacher;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Inventory;
use App\Models\AssetTransaction;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class TeacherInventoryController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Display the inventory assigned to the authenticated teacher.
     */
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $teacherId = Auth::id();

        $inventories = Inventory::where('assigned_to', $teacherId)->latest()->get();
        $personalItems = $inventories->where('assignment_type', 'Personal');
        $facilityItems = $inventories->where('assignment_type', 'Facility');

        return view('teacher.inventory.index', compact('personalItems', 'facilityItems'));
    }

    /**
     * Show form to report damage for an item.
     */
    public function reportDamage(Inventory $inventory): View
    {
        // Security check: Ensure the teacher is actually assigned to this item
        abort_if($inventory->assigned_to !== Auth::id(), 403, 'Unauthorized access.');

        return view('teacher.inventory.damage', compact('inventory'));
    }

    /**
     * Store the damage report.
     */
    public function storeDamage(Request $request, Inventory $inventory)
    {
        abort_if($inventory->assigned_to !== Auth::id(), 403);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'condition' => ['required', 'in:Needs Minor Repair,Needs Major Repair,Unserviceable,Missing'],
            'notes'     => ['required', 'string'],
            'photo'     => ['nullable', 'image', 'max:2048'],
        ]);

        $photoPath = null;
        if ($request->hasFile('photo')) {
            $photoPath = $request->file('photo')->store('inventory_photos', 'public');
        }

        // 1. Update the master inventory condition
        $inventory->update(['condition' => $validated['condition']]);

        // 2. Log the transaction for the Custodian to see
        AssetTransaction::create([
            'inventory_id' => $inventory->id,
            'user_id'      => Auth::id(),
            'action_type'  => 'Condition Change',
            'quantity'     => 1,
            'status'       => 'Completed',
            'notes'        => $validated['notes'],
            'photo_path'   => $photoPath,
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('teacher.inventory.index')
                         ->with('success', 'Damage report submitted to the Property Custodian.');
    }

    /**
     * Show form to log student borrowing.
     */
    public function logBorrow(Inventory $inventory): View
    {
        abort_if($inventory->assigned_to !== Auth::id(), 403);

        return view('teacher.inventory.borrow', compact('inventory'));
    }

    /**
     * Store the borrow transaction.
     */
    public function storeBorrow(Request $request, Inventory $inventory)
    {
        abort_if($inventory->assigned_to !== Auth::id(), 403);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'borrower_name'        => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'action_type'          => ['required', 'in:Borrowed,Consumed'],
            'quantity'             => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:' . $inventory->quantity],
            'expected_return_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'notes'                => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ]);

        // If it's a consumable, deduct it permanently from the master inventory
        if ($validated['action_type'] === 'Consumed') {
            $inventory->decrement('quantity', $validated['quantity']);
        }

        AssetTransaction::create([
            'inventory_id'         => $inventory->id,
            'user_id'              => Auth::id(),
            'action_type'          => $validated['action_type'],
            'quantity'             => $validated['quantity'],
            'borrower_name'        => $validated['borrower_name'],
            'borrower_type'        => 'Student',
            'borrowed_at'          => now(),
            'expected_return_date' => $validated['expected_return_date'],
            'status'               => $validated['action_type'] === 'Consumed' ? 'Completed' : 'Active',
            'notes'                => $validated['notes'],
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('teacher.inventory.index')
                         ->with('success', 'Transaction successfully logged.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasOne;

class Asset extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $fillable = [
        'name',
        'serial_number',
        'asset_type',
        'condition_status',
        'status',
        'acquisition_date',
        'notes',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'acquisition_date' => 'date',
        ];
    }

    public function assignments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(AssetAssignment::class);
    }

    public function currentAssignment(): HasOne
    {
        return $this->hasOne(AssetAssignment::class)->whereNull('released_at')->latestOfMany('assigned_at');
    }

    public function hasUnresolvedAccountability(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this->condition_status, ['damaged', 'lost'], true)
            && $this->currentAssignment()->exists();
    }
}

FILE: app/Models/Setting.php
==================================================

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

class Setting extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $fillable = ['key', 'value'];

    /**
     * Easily retrieve a setting value by its key.
     *
     * @param string $key
     * @param mixed $default Fallback value if the key doesn't exist
     * @return mixed
     */
    public static function get($key, $default = null)
    {
        $setting = self::where('key', $key)->first();
        return $setting ? $setting->value : $default;
    }

    /**
     * Easily update or create a new setting.
     *
     * @param string $key
     * @param mixed $value
     * @return void
     */
    public static function set($key, $value)
    {
        self::updateOrCreate(
            ['key' => $key],
            ['value' => $value]
        );
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

class Student extends Model
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $fillable = [
        'lrn',
        'school_year',      // Added this field
        'first_name',
        'last_name',
        'middle_name',
        'extension_name',
        'gender',
        'birth_date',
        'grade_level',
        'section',
        'curriculum',
        'status',
        'last_synced_at',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'last_synced_at' => 'datetime',
        ];
    }

    public function incidentReports(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(IncidentReport::class);
    }

    public function unresolvedMajorIncidentReports(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->incidentReports()
            ->where('severity', 'major')
            ->whereNotIn('status', ['resolved', 'closed']);
    }

    public function getFullNameAttribute(): string
    {
        return trim(collect([$this->first_name, $this->middle_name, $this->last_name])->filter()->implode(' '));
    }

    public function isEligibleForGoodMoral(): bool
    {
        return ! $this->unresolvedMajorIncidentReports()->exists();
    }
}

FILE: app/Models/User.php
==================================================

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\Permission;
use App\Models\UserPermission;

class User extends Authenticatable
{
    use HasFactory, Notifiable;

    protected $fillable = [
        'employee_id',
        'first_name',
        'last_name',
        'email',
        'password',
        'current_tier',
        'is_active',
        'last_login_ip',
        'last_login_at',
        'suspicious_activity',
        'email_verified_at',
        'deped_rank',
        'department',
        'is_verified',
        'verified_by',
    ];

    protected $hidden = [
        'password',
        'remember_token',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'email_verified_at' => 'datetime',
            'password' => 'hashed',
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
        ];
    }

    public function roles(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(Role::class, 'role_user')->withTimestamps();
    }

    public function permissions(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(Permission::class, 'user_permissions')
            ->using(UserPermission::class)
            ->withPivot('granted_at')
            ->withTimestamps();
    }

    public function authoredDailyLessonLogs(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(DailyLessonLog::class, 'author_id');
    }

    public function reviewedDailyLessonLogs(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(DailyLessonLog::class, 'reviewer_id');
    }

    public function cotRatings(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(CotRating::class, 'teacher_id');
    }

    public function professionalGrowthEntries(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(ProfessionalGrowth::class, 'teacher_id');
    }

    public function incidentReports(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(IncidentReport::class, 'teacher_id');
    }

    public function counselingInterventions(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(CounselingIntervention::class, 'counselor_id');
    }

    public function assetAssignments(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(AssetAssignment::class);
    }

    public function getNameAttribute(): string
    {
        return trim($this->first_name.' '.$this->last_name);
    }

    public function setNameAttribute(string $value): void
    {
        $trimmed = trim($value);

        if ($trimmed === '') {
            return;
        }

        $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', $trimmed, 2) ?: [];
        $this->attributes['first_name'] = $parts[0] ?? '';
        $this->attributes['last_name'] = $parts[1] ?? '';
    }

    public function initials(): string
    {
        return Str::upper(Str::substr($this->first_name, 0, 1).Str::substr($this->last_name, 0, 1));
    }

    public function hasPermissionTo(string $actionName): bool
    {
        if ($this->roles()->where('name', 'admin')->exists()) {
            return true;
        }

        return $this->permissions()->where('action_name', $actionName)->exists();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

class UserPermission extends Pivot
{
    /**
     * Indicates if the IDs are auto-incrementing.
     *
     * @var bool
     */
    public $incrementing = true;

    /**
     * The table associated with the pivot model.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $table = 'user_permissions';

    /**
     * The attributes that are mass assignable.
     *
     * @var array<int, string>
     */
    protected $fillable = [
        'user_id',
        'permission_id',
        'granted_at',
    ];

    /**
     * The attributes that should be cast to native types.
     *
     * @var array<string, string>
     */
    protected $casts = [
        'granted_at' => 'datetime',
    ];
}

FILE: app/Services/Ai/DllPrecheckerClient.php

<?php

namespace App\Services\Ai;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Throwable;

class DllPrecheckerClient
{
    private const MIN_FALLBACK_SCORE = 0.2;

    public function precheck(array $payload): array
    {
        $external = $this->callExternalService($payload);

        if ($external !== null) {
            return $external;
        }

        return $this->localFallback($payload);
    }

    protected function callExternalService(array $payload): ?array
    {
        $url = config('services.ai_prechecker.url');

        if (! $url) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            $response = Http::timeout((int) config('services.ai_prechecker.timeout', 10))
                ->acceptJson()
                ->withToken((string) config('services.ai_prechecker.token'))
                ->post(rtrim($url, '/').'/v1/dll-precheck', [
                    'subject' => $payload['subject'] ?? null,
                    'objectives' => $payload['objectives'] ?? null,
                    'content' => $payload['content'] ?? null,
                    'learning_resources' => $payload['learning_resources'] ?? null,
                    'procedures' => $payload['procedures'] ?? null,
                    'reflection' => $payload['reflection'] ?? null,
                ]);

            if (! $response->successful()) {
                return null;
            }

            return $response->json();
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    protected function localFallback(array $payload): array
    {
        $required = ['subject', 'objectives', 'content', 'learning_resources', 'procedures'];
        $missing = [];

        foreach ($required as $field) {
            if (blank($payload[$field] ?? null)) {
                $missing[] = $field;
            }
        }

        $passed = $missing === [];

        $requiredCount = max(1, count($required));

        return [
            'passed' => $passed,
            'score' => $passed ? 1.0 : max(self::MIN_FALLBACK_SCORE, 1 - (count($missing) / $requiredCount)),
            'provider' => 'local-fallback',
            'feedback' => $passed
                ? ['DLL draft is complete enough to submit for review.']
                : ['Please complete the following sections: '.implode(', ', $missing).'.'],
        ];
    }
}
