<?php

namespace App\Services;

class TrackEdCoTeacher
{
    /**
     * Generates a highly contextual pedagogical suggestion based on the subject and the teacher's goal.
     */
    public function generateSuggestion(string $subject, string $intentions, string $type): string
    {
        $subject = strtolower(trim($subject));

        // 1. AI "Thinking" Step: Extract the core topic
        $topic = $this->extractCoreTopic($intentions);

        // 2. AI "Thinking" Step: Detect cognitive demand
        $cognitiveLevel = $this->detectCognitiveLevel($intentions);

        // 3. Route to the appropriate dynamic generator
        if ($type === 'learning_experience') {
            return $this->buildActivity($subject, $topic, $cognitiveLevel);
        }

        return $this->buildAssessment($subject, $topic, $cognitiveLevel);
    }

    /**
     * NLP Heuristic: Strips pedagogical filler words to find the actual subject matter.
     * Example: "To understand the process of photosynthesis" -> "process of photosynthesis"
     */
    protected function extractCoreTopic(string $intentions): string
    {
        $clean = strtolower($intentions);

        // Phrases to aggressively remove
        $fillerPhrases = [
            '/^the (learner|learners|student|students) will (be able to )?/i',
            '/^(to )?(understand|learn|know|comprehend|identify|discuss|analyze|evaluate|create|describe) /i',
            '/\b(about|how to|the concept of)\b/i'
        ];

        foreach ($fillerPhrases as $pattern) {
            $clean = preg_replace($pattern, '', $clean);
        }

        return trim($clean) ?: 'the core concepts'; // Fallback if they only typed a single word
    }

    /**
     * Maps the teacher's verbs to Bloom's Taxonomy to adjust the difficulty of the suggestion.
     */
    protected function detectCognitiveLevel(string $intentions): string
    {
        $intentions = strtolower($intentions);

        $hots = ['create', 'design', 'evaluate', 'judge', 'analyze', 'compare', 'formulate'];
        $lots = ['define', 'list', 'memorize', 'identify', 'state', 'name'];

        foreach ($hots as $verb) { if (str_contains($intentions, $verb)) return 'HOTS'; }
        foreach ($lots as $verb) { if (str_contains($intentions, $verb)) return 'LOTS'; }

        return 'MOTS'; // Default to application/understanding
    }

    /**
     * ==========================================
     * DYNAMIC ACTIVITY BUILDERS
     * ==========================================
     */
    protected function buildActivity(string $subject, string $topic, string $level): string
    {
        // Randomize groupings so the AI feels dynamic if clicked multiple times
        $groupings = ['in pairs', 'in small triads', 'in groups of four', 'collaboratively'];
        $group = $groupings[array_rand($groupings)];

        if (str_contains($subject, 'math')) {
            if ($level === 'HOTS') {
                return "CPA Approach (Abstract): Present an open-ended, real-world scenario involving {$topic}. Have students work {$group} to formulate multiple mathematical pathways to solve it, then defend their chosen method to the class.";
            }
            return "Guided Practice (I Do, We Do, You Do): Demonstrate the step-by-step calculation for {$topic} on the board. Next, solve a similar problem {$group}. Finally, have students attempt one independently.";
        }

        if (str_contains($subject, 'science')) {
            if ($level === 'LOTS') {
                return "5E Model (Engage): Start with a discrepant event or a short video clip related to {$topic}. Ask students to write down 2 observations and 1 question they have before starting the formal lecture.";
            }
            return "5E Model (Explore & Explain): Set up learning stations. Have students work {$group} to manipulate models or data related to {$topic}. Ask them to construct their own explanations before you provide the scientific definitions.";
        }

        if (str_contains($subject, 'english') || str_contains($subject, 'filipino')) {
            return "Contextualized Application: Provide a localized reading text or visual prompt. Have students work {$group} to analyze how {$topic} is applied in the material, then task them with producing a short, original output using the same structure.";
        }

        if (str_contains($subject, 'values') || str_contains($subject, 'esp') || str_contains($subject, 'ap') || str_contains($subject, 'araling panlipunan')) {
            return "4As Framework (Activity & Analysis): Initiate a short role-play or present a localized dilemma regarding {$topic}. Follow this with a processing discussion where students work {$group} to answer: 'What happened?', 'Why did it happen?', and 'How does this reflect our core values?'";
        }

        if (str_contains($subject, 'tle') || str_contains($subject, 'mapeh')) {
            return "Experiential Learning: Conduct a brief demonstration of the proper techniques for {$topic}. Immediately transition into a supervised practicum where students attempt the skill {$group} while you provide real-time corrective feedback.";
        }

        // The ultimate fallback
        return "Interactive Jigsaw: Break the concept of {$topic} into smaller chunks. Assign one chunk to each student {$group}. Give them 10 minutes to master their specific part, then have them teach it to their peers.";
    }

    /**
     * ==========================================
     * DYNAMIC ASSESSMENT BUILDERS
     * ==========================================
     */
    protected function buildAssessment(string $subject, string $topic, string $level): string
    {
        if ($level === 'HOTS') {
            return "Performance Task (Authentic Assessment): Ask students to produce a localized output or solve a case study applying {$topic}. Grade the output using a 4-point holistic rubric focusing on critical thinking and application rather than pure recall.";
        }

        if (str_contains($subject, 'math') || str_contains($subject, 'science')) {
            return "Formative Assessment (Data-Driven): Administer a 3-to-5 item short quiz specifically targeting {$topic}. Require students to show their step-by-step logic. Collect papers immediately to check for common misconceptions before the period ends.";
        }

        if (str_contains($subject, 'english') || str_contains($subject, 'filipino')) {
            return "Peer Review & Constructive Critique: Have students exchange their written outputs regarding {$topic}. Provide them with a simple 3-point checklist to evaluate their partner's work, fostering collaborative assessment.";
        }

        // Default quick formative check
        return "Exit Ticket (3-2-1 Method): Five minutes before the bell, ask students to write on a half-sheet of paper: 3 facts they learned about {$topic}, 2 interesting concepts, and 1 question they still have.";
    }
}

FILE: app/Services/TrackEdSmartEngine.php

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\DailyLessonLog;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * TrackEdSmartEngine
 *
 * Rule-based, fully self-contained analysis engine for DepEd Daily Lesson Logs (DLL).
 * Now includes Context-Awareness (Plagiarism detection) and Instructional Alignment.
 */
class TrackEdSmartEngine
{
    /** Weighting profile for the overall compliance score (should sum to 100). */
    protected array $weights = [
        'completeness'     => 30,
        'assessment'       => 20,
        'reflection'       => 15,
        'cognitive_demand' => 20,
        'originality'      => 15, // NEW: Weight for not copy-pasting
    ];

    /** Revised Bloom's / Anderson taxonomy verbs, grouped by cognitive level. */
    protected array $taxonomy = [
        'remembering'   => ['define', 'list', 'recall', 'name', 'state', 'identify', 'label', 'memorize'],
        'understanding' => ['describe', 'explain', 'discuss', 'summarize', 'classify', 'interpret', 'paraphrase'],
        'applying'      => ['apply', 'demonstrate', 'illustrate', 'solve', 'use', 'compute', 'implement'],
        'analyzing'     => ['analyze', 'compare', 'contrast', 'differentiate', 'examine', 'organize', 'distinguish'],
        'evaluating'    => ['evaluate', 'judge', 'critique', 'justify', 'argue', 'assess', 'defend', 'appraise'],
        'creating'      => ['create', 'design', 'formulate', 'construct', 'compose', 'devise', 'plan', 'generate', 'produce'],
    ];

    protected array $lotsLevels = ['remembering', 'understanding'];
    protected array $motsLevels = ['applying', 'analyzing'];
    protected array $hotsLevels = ['evaluating', 'creating'];

    public function analyzeLessonPlan(DailyLessonLog $dll): array
    {
        $dll->load(['entries', 'author']);
        $entries   = $dll->entries;
        $totalDays = $entries->count();

        if ($totalDays === 0) {
            return $this->blankMatrixResponse();
        }

        $cognitive    = $this->scanCognitiveDemand($dll);
        $completeness = $this->scanCompleteness($entries);
        $history      = $this->checkSystemHistory($dll, $entries); // NEW: Contextual Check

        $perDay       = $this->buildPerDayBreakdown($entries);
        $score        = $this->computeComplianceScore($completeness, $cognitive, $history, $totalDays);

        return [
            'brief'                 => $this->buildBrief($totalDays, $cognitive, $completeness, $history, $score),
            'suggested_feedback'    => $this->buildFeedback($completeness, $cognitive, $history, $totalDays),
            'compliance_score'      => $score,
            'rating'                => $this->scoreToRating($score),
            'cognitive_profile'     => $cognitive,
            'completeness'          => $completeness,
            'strengths'             => $this->identifyStrengths($completeness, $cognitive, $history),
            'areas_for_improvement' => $this->identifyImprovements($completeness, $cognitive, $history),
            'per_day'               => $perDay,
        ];
    }

    protected function blankMatrixResponse(): array
    {
        return [
            'brief'                 => "🚨 Critical: Matrix is completely blank. No instructional days recorded.",
            'suggested_feedback'    => "Please complete your daily procedures before routing for supervision.",
            'compliance_score'      => 0,
            'rating'                => 'Not Ratable',
            'cognitive_profile'     => null,
            'completeness'          => null,
            'strengths'             => [],
            'areas_for_improvement' => ['No entries to evaluate.'],
            'per_day'               => [],
        ];
    }

    protected function scanCognitiveDemand(DailyLessonLog $dll): array
    {
        $text = strtolower(trim(
            ($dll->competencies ?? '') . ' ' .
            ($dll->content_standard ?? '') . ' ' .
            ($dll->performance_standard ?? '')
        ));

        $hits = [];
        foreach ($this->taxonomy as $level => $verbs) {
            $hits[$level] = array_values(array_filter($verbs, fn ($verb) => str_contains($text, $verb)));
        }

        $lotsCount = array_sum(array_map(fn ($l) => count($hits[$l]), $this->lotsLevels));
        $motsCount = array_sum(array_map(fn ($l) => count($hits[$l]), $this->motsLevels));
        $hotsCount = array_sum(array_map(fn ($l) => count($hits[$l]), $this->hotsLevels));

        $verdict = match (true) {
            $hotsCount > 0 && $hotsCount >= $lotsCount => 'hots',
            $motsCount > 0 && $motsCount >= $lotsCount => 'mots',
            $lotsCount > 0                              => 'lots',
            default                                     => 'undetermined',
        };

        return [
            'verdict'    => $verdict,
            'hits'       => $hits,
            'lots_count' => $lotsCount,
            'mots_count' => $motsCount,
            'hots_count' => $hotsCount,
        ];
    }

    protected function scanCompleteness(Collection $entries): array
    {
        $missingAssessments = 0;
        $missingReflections = 0;
        $missingActivities  = 0;

        foreach ($entries as $entry) {
            if ($this->isBlank($entry->procedure_e ?? null)) $missingAssessments++;
            if ($this->isBlank($entry->reflection_notes ?? null)) $missingReflections++;
            if ($this->isBlank($entry->procedure_a ?? null)) $missingActivities++;
        }

        return [
            'missing_assessments' => $missingAssessments,
            'missing_reflections' => $missingReflections,
            'missing_activities'  => $missingActivities,
        ];
    }

    /** NEW: Checks the database for copy-pasting from last week */
    protected function checkSystemHistory(DailyLessonLog $dll, Collection $entries): array
    {
        $currentActivitiesText = "";
        foreach ($entries as $entry) {
            $currentActivitiesText .= strtolower($entry->procedure_a . " ");
        }

        $lastLog = DailyLessonLog::with('entries')
            ->where('author_id', $dll->author_id)
            ->where('id', '!=', $dll->id)
            ->latest('created_at')
            ->first();

        $isCopyPasted = false;

        if ($lastLog && !empty(trim($currentActivitiesText))) {
            $lastActivitiesText = "";
            foreach ($lastLog->entries as $entry) {
                $lastActivitiesText .= strtolower($entry->procedure_a . " ");
            }

            if (!empty(trim($lastActivitiesText))) {
                similar_text($currentActivitiesText, $lastActivitiesText, $percentSimilarity);
                if ($percentSimilarity > 85) {
                    $isCopyPasted = true;
                }
            }
        }

        return [
            'is_copy_pasted' => $isCopyPasted
        ];
    }

    protected function buildPerDayBreakdown(Collection $entries): array
    {
        return $entries->values()->map(function ($entry, $i) {
            $issues = [];
            if ($this->isBlank($entry->procedure_a ?? null)) $issues[] = 'No instructional activities logged.';
            if ($this->isBlank($entry->procedure_e ?? null)) $issues[] = 'No formative assessment logged.';
            if ($this->isBlank($entry->reflection_notes ?? null)) $issues[] = 'No reflection notes.';

            return [
                'day'    => $i + 1,
                'date'   => $entry->date ?? null,
                'status' => empty($issues) ? 'complete' : 'incomplete',
                'issues' => $issues,
            ];
        })->toArray();
    }

    protected function computeComplianceScore(array $completeness, array $cognitive, array $history, int $totalDays): int
    {
        $activityRate     = 1 - ($completeness['missing_activities'] / $totalDays);
        $assessmentRate   = 1 - ($completeness['missing_assessments'] / $totalDays);
        $reflectionRate   = 1 - ($completeness['missing_reflections'] / $totalDays);

        $completenessRate = ($activityRate + $assessmentRate + $reflectionRate) / 3;

        $cognitiveScore = match ($cognitive['verdict']) {
            'hots'  => 1.0,
            'mots'  => 0.75,
            'lots'  => 0.5,
            default => 0.3,
        };

        $originalityScore = $history['is_copy_pasted'] ? 0.0 : 1.0;

        $score = ($completenessRate * $this->weights['completeness'])
            + ($assessmentRate * $this->weights['assessment'])
            + ($reflectionRate * $this->weights['reflection'])
            + ($cognitiveScore * $this->weights['cognitive_demand'])
            + ($originalityScore * $this->weights['originality']);

        return (int) round(max(0, min(100, $score)));
    }

    protected function scoreToRating(int $score): string
    {
        return match (true) {
            $score >= 90 => 'Highly Proficient',
            $score >= 75 => 'Proficient',
            $score >= 60 => 'Developing',
            default      => 'Needs Immediate Support',
        };
    }

    protected function buildBrief(int $totalDays, array $cognitive, array $completeness, array $history, int $score): string
    {
        $brief = "🧠 TrackEd Engine Scan: Teacher logged {$totalDays} day(s). ";

        if ($history['is_copy_pasted']) {
            $brief .= "⚠️ Red Flag: Activities are highly identical to the previous week's submission. ";
        }

        $brief .= match ($cognitive['verdict']) {
            'hots'  => "Competencies show strong High-Order Thinking (HOTS) alignment. ",
            'mots'  => "Competencies show moderate-order cognitive demand. ",
            'lots'  => "Competencies lean towards foundational recall (LOTS). ",
            default => "Cognitive level of competencies could not be determined. ",
        };

        if ($completeness['missing_activities'] > 0) {
            $brief .= "{$completeness['missing_activities']} day(s) lack instructional activities. ";
        }
        if ($completeness['missing_assessments'] > 0) {
            $brief .= "{$completeness['missing_assessments']} day(s) lack explicit formative assessments. ";
        }

        return $brief . "Overall compliance score: {$score}/100.";
    }

    protected function buildFeedback(array $completeness, array $cognitive, array $history, int $totalDays): string
    {
        if ($history['is_copy_pasted']) {
            return "Please review your daily procedures. They appear to be a direct duplicate of last week's lesson log. Ensure activities are updated for the current competencies.";
        }

        if ($completeness['missing_activities'] > 0) {
            return "Please detail your step-by-step instructional procedures for the missing day(s).";
        }

        if ($completeness['missing_assessments'] > 0) {
            return "Please specify your formative evaluation methods (e.g., 5-item quiz) for the missing day(s).";
        }

        if ($completeness['missing_reflections'] === $totalDays) {
            return "Reminder: Post-lesson reflections must be completed to finalize the instructional cycle.";
        }

        if ($cognitive['verdict'] === 'lots') {
            return "Consider revising at least one competency per week to require analysis, evaluation, or creation, rather than recall alone.";
        }

        return "Matrix is highly compliant and well-structured. Checked and noted.";
    }

    protected function identifyStrengths(array $completeness, array $cognitive, array $history): array
    {
        $strengths = [];
        if ($completeness['missing_assessments'] === 0) $strengths[] = 'All days have a mapped formative assessment.';
        if ($completeness['missing_reflections'] === 0) $strengths[] = 'Reflection notes are complete for every logged day.';
        if (in_array($cognitive['verdict'], ['hots', 'mots'])) $strengths[] = 'Competencies engage learners above the recall level.';
        if (!$history['is_copy_pasted'] && $completeness['missing_activities'] === 0) $strengths[] = 'Instructional activities are fully mapped and original.';
        return $strengths;
    }

    protected function identifyImprovements(array $completeness, array $cognitive, array $history): array
    {
        $improvements = [];
        if ($history['is_copy_pasted']) {
            $improvements[] = "Ensure instructional activities are unique to the current week's competencies and not duplicated from past logs.";
        }
        if ($completeness['missing_activities'] > 0) {
            $improvements[] = "{$completeness['missing_activities']} day(s) need detailed instructional procedures.";
        }
        if ($completeness['missing_assessments'] > 0) {
            $improvements[] = "{$completeness['missing_assessments']} day(s) need a stated formative assessment.";
        }
        if ($completeness['missing_reflections'] > 0) {
            $improvements[] = "{$completeness['missing_reflections']} day(s) need reflection notes.";
        }
        if (in_array($cognitive['verdict'], ['lots', 'undetermined'])) {
            $improvements[] = 'Raise the cognitive demand of stated competencies (e.g., shift from "define" to "evaluate" or "create").';
        }
        return $improvements;
    }

    protected function isBlank(?string $value): bool
    {
        return trim((string) $value) === '';
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class EnsureUserHasPermission
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next, string ...$permissions): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if (! $user) {
            abort(403);
        }

        // ADD THIS BYPASS: This allows Admins to pass regardless of specific permissions
        if ($user->role === 'admin') {
            return $next($request);
        }

        // Existing logic for non-admin users
        foreach ($permissions as $permission) {
            if ($user->hasPermissionTo($permission)) {
                return $next($request);
            }
        }

        abort(403);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class EnsureUserHasRole
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next, ...$roles): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if (!$user) return redirect('/login');

        // 1. ADMIN BYPASS - Ensure this matches your DB column exactly
        if ($user->role === 'admin') {
            return $next($request);
        }

        // 2. GET ACTIVE ROLE
        $activeRole = session('active_role');

        // Flatten the roles passed from the route (handles 'counselor|admin')
        $allowedRoles = [];
        foreach ($roles as $r) {
            $allowedRoles = array_merge($allowedRoles, explode('|', $r));
        }

        // 3. DEBUG BLOCK - Uncomment these 3 lines if you get 403 to see exactly why
        /*
        dd([
            'session_active_role' => $activeRole,
            'allowed_roles_for_route' => $allowedRoles,
            'user_has_role_in_db' => $user->roles()->where('name', $activeRole)->exists(),
            'user_db_roles' => $user->roles()->pluck('name')->toArray()
        ]);
        */

        // 4. VALIDATION
        if (!$activeRole) {
            abort(403, 'No active role session found.');
        }

        if (!in_array($activeRole, $allowedRoles)) {
            abort(403, "Role '$activeRole' is not authorized for this route. Allowed: " . implode(', ', $allowedRoles));
        }

        if (!$user->roles()->where('name', $activeRole)->exists()) {
            abort(403, "Database mismatch: You do not have the role '$activeRole' assigned in your account.");
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class EnsureUserIsActive
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if ($user && ! $user->is_active) {
            auth()->logout();
            $request->session()->invalidate();
            $request->session()->regenerateToken();

            return redirect()->route('login')->withErrors([
                'email' => 'Your account is inactive. Please contact the system administrator.',
            ]);
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

FILE: app/Http/Requests/Auth/LoginRequest.php
==================================================

<?php

namespace App\Http\Requests\Auth;

use Illuminate\Auth\Events\Lockout;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class LoginRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function authorize(): bool
    {
        return true;
    }

    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'login' => ['required', 'string'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
        ];
    }

    public function authenticate(): void
    {
        $this->ensureIsNotRateLimited();

        $login = $this->input('login');

        // Logic: Decide if user used email or employee_id
        $field = filter_var($login, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) ? 'email' : 'employee_id';

        if (! Auth::attempt([$field => $login, 'password' => $this->password], $this->boolean('remember'))) {
            RateLimiter::hit($this->throttleKey());

            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'login' => trans('auth.failed'),
            ]);
        }

        RateLimiter::clear($this->throttleKey());
    }

    public function ensureIsNotRateLimited(): void
    {
        if (! RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts($this->throttleKey(), 5)) {
            return;
        }

        event(new Lockout($this));

        $seconds = RateLimiter::availableIn($this->throttleKey());

        throw ValidationException::withMessages([
            'login' => trans('auth.throttle', [
                'seconds' => $seconds,
                'minutes' => ceil($seconds / 60),
            ]),
        ]);
    }

    public function throttleKey(): string
    {
        return Str::transliterate(Str::lower($this->input('login')).'|'.$this->ip());
    }
}

FILE: app/Imports/Sf1Import.php
==================================================

<?php

namespace App\Imports;

use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use App\Models\LisStaging;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\ToCollection;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithCalculatedFormulas;

class Sf1Import implements ToCollection, WithCalculatedFormulas
{
    public $inserted = 0;
    public $updated = 0;
    protected $schoolYear;

    // Persist grade and section across the whole file
    protected $currentGradeLevel = 'Unknown';
    protected $currentSection = 'Unknown';

    public function __construct($schoolYear)
    {
        $this->schoolYear = $schoolYear;
    }

    /**
     * @param Collection $collection
     */
    public function collection(Collection $rows)
    {
        foreach ($rows as $row) {

            // 1. COLLAPSE MERGED CELLS (The Fix)
            // Remove all nulls or empty strings, then re-index the array so values are side-by-side
            $cleanedRow = array_values(array_filter($row->toArray(), function($value) {
                return $value !== null && trim((string)$value) !== '';
            }));

            // If the row is completely empty after cleaning, skip it
            if (empty($cleanedRow)) {
                continue;
            }

            // 2. AUTO-DETECT GRADE AND SECTION FROM THE HEADER
            // Because we cleaned the array, the target value is always immediately after the label
            foreach ($cleanedRow as $index => $cellValue) {
                $cellString = trim((string)$cellValue);

                if (stripos($cellString, 'Grade Level') !== false && isset($cleanedRow[$index + 1])) {
                    $this->currentGradeLevel = trim((string)$cleanedRow[$index + 1]);
                }

                if (stripos($cellString, 'Section') !== false && isset($cleanedRow[$index + 1])) {
                    $this->currentSection = trim((string)$cleanedRow[$index + 1]);
                }
            }

            // 3. IDENTIFY STUDENT ROWS
            // After cleaning, Index 0 is LRN, 1 is Name, 2 is Sex, 3 is Birthdate
            $lrn = trim((string)$cleanedRow[0]);

            // Check if the first item is a 12-digit LRN
            if (preg_match('/^\d{12}$/', $lrn)) {

                // Safely grab the data using our predictable indexes
                $rawName   = isset($cleanedRow[1]) ? trim((string)$cleanedRow[1]) : '';
                $gender    = isset($cleanedRow[2]) ? trim((string)$cleanedRow[2]) : '';
                $birthDate = isset($cleanedRow[3]) ? trim((string)$cleanedRow[3]) : '';

                // Standardize Gender (M -> Male, F -> Female)
                if (strtoupper($gender) === 'M') $gender = 'Male';
                if (strtoupper($gender) === 'F') $gender = 'Female';

                // 4. SMART CATCHER: PARSE THE NAME
                $parsedName = $this->parseName($rawName);

                // 5. SAVE TO DATABASE
                $record = LisStaging::updateOrCreate(
                    [
                        'lrn'         => $lrn,
                        'school_year' => $this->schoolYear,
                    ],
                    [
                        'last_name'      => $parsedName['last_name'],
                        'first_name'     => $parsedName['first_name'],
                        'middle_name'    => $parsedName['middle_name'],
                        'extension_name' => $parsedName['extension_name'],
                        'gender'         => $gender,
                        'birthdate'      => $birthDate,
                        'grade_level'    => $this->currentGradeLevel,
                        'section'        => $this->currentSection,
                    ]
                );

                // Track analytics for the controller summary
                if ($record->wasRecentlyCreated) {
                    $this->inserted++;
                } else {
                    $this->updated++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Parse DepEd Name Format: "LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, EXTENSION, MIDDLENAME"
     * Handles names with and without extensions.
     */
    private function parseName($rawName)
    {
        // Split the string by comma
        $parts = array_map('trim', explode(',', $rawName));

        $lastName = $parts[0] ?? '';
        $firstName = '';
        $middleName = null;
        $extensionName = null;

        $count = count($parts);

        if ($count === 2) {
            // E.g., "DELA CRUZ, JUAN"
            $firstName = $parts[1];
        } elseif ($count === 3) {
            // E.g., "CAGBAY, MHARK BERNARD, MILLIONES"
            $firstName = $parts[1];
            $middleName = $parts[2];
        } elseif ($count >= 4) {
            // E.g., "CALIBO, ERNIE, JR., CAMINO"
            // The extension is typically the 3rd item, and the middle name is the 4th
            $firstName = $parts[1];
            $extensionName = $parts[2];
            $middleName = $parts[3];
        }

        return [
            'last_name'      => $lastName,
            'first_name'     => $firstName,
            'middle_name'    => $middleName,
            'extension_name' => $extensionName,
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\Attributes\On;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class DssActionDesk extends Component
{
    public $facultyRankings = [];
    public $behaviorSummary;
    public $assetSummary;

    public $activeContext = 'faculty';
    public $input = '';
    public $messages = [];

    // NEW: Interactive State Variables
    public $documentDrafted = false;
    public $draftedContent = '';
    public $isReportMode = false; // Controls the UI flip

    public function mount($facultyRankings, $behaviorSummary, $assetSummary)
    {
        $this->facultyRankings = json_decode(json_encode($facultyRankings), true) ?? [];
        $this->behaviorSummary = $behaviorSummary;
        $this->assetSummary = $assetSummary;

        $this->messages[] = [
            'role' => 'ai',
            'text' => "SYSTEM READY // INITIALIZING SYSTEM CORE DIAGNOSTICS...\n\nHello Principal. I am your automated Data Diagnostics Mainframe. I have compiled the database logs into structured analytical vectors. Select a module above or request an intelligence briefing."
        ];
    }

    #[On('set-context')]
    public function setContext($context)
    {
        $this->activeContext = $context;
        $this->documentDrafted = false;
        $this->draftedContent = '';
        $this->isReportMode = false; // Reset view

        $this->messages = [[
            'role' => 'ai',
            'text' => "FOCUS SHIFT // MODULE CHANNEL MOUNTED: [" . strtoupper($context) . "]\n\nMainframe is locked onto " . ucfirst($context) . " metrics. Ready to perform systemic evaluation or isolate diagnostic anomalies."
        ]];
    }

    public function generateDocument()
    {
        if ($this->activeContext === 'behavior') {
            $this->input = "COMMAND: Generate full Predictive Behavioral Risk & Security Diagnostics Report.";
        } elseif ($this->activeContext === 'asset') {
            $this->input = "COMMAND: Generate full Lifecycle Depreciation & Procurement Analytics Report.";
        } else {
            $this->input = "COMMAND: Generate full Instructional Compliance & Technical Assistance Data Matrix.";
        }

        $this->sendMessage(true);
    }

    public function toggleReportMode()
    {
        // Flips the UI from the Chat to the Full-Screen Report
        $this->isReportMode = !$this->isReportMode;
    }

    public function sendMessage($isDocumentDraft = false)
    {
        if (trim($this->input) === '') return;

        $userMessage = $this->input;

        $this->messages[] = [
            'role' => 'user',
            'text' => $isDocumentDraft ? "EXECUTE: Compile Analytical Diagnostic Report." : $userMessage
        ];

        $this->input = '';

        if (!$isDocumentDraft) {
            $this->documentDrafted = false;
            $this->isReportMode = false;
        }

        // Gather structural data blocks
        $contextData = "";
        if ($this->activeContext === 'behavior') {
            $contextData = "Behavioral Raw Metrics:\n" . $this->behaviorSummary;
        } elseif ($this->activeContext === 'asset') {
            $contextData = "Inventory Raw Metrics:\n" . $this->assetSummary;
        } else {
            $contextData = "Granular Faculty Log Metrics:\n";
            foreach ($this->facultyRankings as $index => $teacher) {
                $rank = $index + 1;
                $contextData .= "[RANK #{$rank}] Personnel: {$teacher['name']} // Stats: {$teacher['compliance_rate']}% Compliance Index ({$teacher['checked']} Approved Vectors, {$teacher['needs_revision']} Flagged Revisions).\n";
            }
        }

        $systemPrompt = "You are the TrackEd Decision Support System (DSS) Core Mainframe. Your function is to process raw administrative metrics into highly advanced, clinical, intelligent diagnostic readouts for the School Head.

        CURRENT OPERATIONAL LAYER: [" . strtoupper($this->activeContext) . "]
        LIVE DATABASE VECTOR DATA:
        \n{$contextData}

        STRICT PROTOCOLS FOR REPORT GENERATION:
        1. TERMINOLOGY: Use authoritative, systems-engineering, and advanced data science vocabulary (e.g., 'compliance index', 'depreciation threshold', 'anomaly detection', 'risk vectors').
        2. DO NOT write an essay, a memo, or a standard letter. No salutations, no signature greetings.
        3. MANDATORY STRUCTURAL ARCHITECTURE (Use exact titles in ALL CAPS):
           I. CORE OVERVIEW & HEALTH INDEX
           II. GRANULAR DIAGNOSTIC DATA MATRIX
           III. PREDICTIVE VARIANCE MODELLING
           IV. STRATEGIC DECISION DIRECTIVES
        4. ABSOLUTE LIMITATION: Never track or mention student absenteeism metrics under any circumstances. Do not use markdown bolding (**) or code blocks (```). Format using clean spacing.";

        try {
            $apiKey = env('GEMINI_API_KEY');
            if (empty($apiKey)) throw new \Exception("Core Configuration Error: Access Key Absent.");

            $baseUrl = 'https://' . 'generativelanguage.googleapis.com';
            $endpoint = '/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=';

            $response = Http::withOptions(['verify' => false])
                ->withHeaders(['Content-Type' => 'application/json'])
                ->timeout(60)->post($baseUrl . $endpoint . trim($apiKey), [
                'contents' => [
                    ['parts' => [['text' => $systemPrompt . "\n\nUser Request: " . $userMessage]]]
                ],
                'generationConfig' => ['temperature' => 0.1]
            ]);

            if ($response->successful()) {
                $result = $response->json();
                $aiText = $result['candidates'][0]['content']['parts'][0]['text'] ?? 'System processing failure.';
                $cleanText = trim($aiText);

                $this->messages[] = ['role' => 'ai', 'text' => $cleanText];

                if ($isDocumentDraft) {
                    $this->documentDrafted = true;
                    $this->draftedContent = $cleanText;
                }

            } else {
                $this->messages[] = ['role' => 'ai', 'text' => '⚠️ CRITICAL MAINFRAME EXCEPTION: ' . $response->body()];
            }

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('DSS Action Desk Error: ' . $e->getMessage());
            $this->messages[] = ['role' => 'ai', 'text' => '⚠️ CONNECTION DISRUPTED: ' . $e->getMessage()];
        }

        $this->dispatch('chat-updated');
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.dss-action-desk');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Livewire\Component;

class SystemGuideChat extends Component
{
    public array $messages = [];
    public string $input = '';

    protected string $systemPrompt = <<<'SYSTEM'
You are "System Guide", an embedded AI assistant inside a school management web application built with Laravel and Livewire called TrackEd.

You help teachers, advisers, department heads, guidance staff, and administrators use the system correctly.

MODULES:

1. DAILY LESSON LOG (DLL)
- Create lesson plans (MATATAG / ILAW formats)
- Submit for review to the School Head
- Receive comments, Revise, and Resubmit
Navigation: Dashboard -> Lesson Logs → New DLL

2. BEHAVIOR MANAGEMENT (Log Incident)
- Create incident reports
- Minor, Major, Positive reports
- Visible to Guidance and Admin
Navigation: Dashboard -> Child Protection -> Log Incident

3. INVENTORY MANAGEMENT (My Inventory)
- Sign E-PARs (Property Acknowledgement Receipts)
- Monitor property clearance status
Navigation: Dashboard -> Accountability -> View Assets

4. E-PORTFOLIO VAULT
- Curate career achievements, seminars, and recognitions
- Upload PDF/Images as Means of Verification (MOV)
Navigation: Dashboard -> Access E-Portfolio

RULES:
- Answer in short, clear steps.
- Stay focused on the school management system.
- If unsure, advise contacting the system administrator.
- Never invent features that are not listed in the MODULES section above.
SYSTEM;

    public function mount(): void
    {
        $this->messages = [
            [
                'role' => 'assistant',
                'text' => "👋 Hello! I'm your System Guide.\nHow can I help you today?",
            ],
        ];
    }

    // This handles BOTH the quick-action buttons AND the free-text input
    public function sendPrompt(string $key = '', string $label = ''): void
    {
        // 1. Determine what the user actually said
        // If they clicked a button, $label will have text. Otherwise, use what they typed in $this->input.
        $userText = trim($label !== '' ? $label : $this->input);

        if (empty($userText)) {
            return;
        }

        // 2. Add their message to the chat UI immediately
        $this->messages[] = [
            'role' => 'user',
            'text' => $userText,
        ];

        // Clear the input box
        $this->input = '';

        // 3. Format the conversation history for the Anthropic API
        // Claude expects an array of ['role' => 'user/assistant', 'content' => '...']
        $conversation = [];
        foreach ($this->messages as $msg) {
            $conversation[] = [
                'role' => $msg['role'] === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',
                'content' => $msg['text'],
            ];
        }

        // 4. Send the request to Anthropic
        try {
            // Note: Make sure 'services.anthropic.api_key' is set in your config/services.php
            // and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is in your .env file
            $response = Http::withHeaders([
                'x-api-key' => config('services.anthropic.api_key'),
                'anthropic-version' => '2023-06-01',
                'content-type' => 'application/json',
            ])->post('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', [
                // 'claude-3-haiku-20240307' is highly recommended here for fast, cheap, snappy chat responses
                'model' => 'claude-3-haiku-20240307',
                'max_tokens' => 1000,
                'system' => $this->systemPrompt,
                'messages' => $conversation,
            ]);

            if (!$response->successful()) {
                logger()->error('Anthropic API Error', [
                    'status' => $response->status(),
                    'body' => $response->body(),
                ]);
                $reply = '⚠️ AI service temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.';
            } else {
                $reply = $response->json('content.0.text') ?? 'I received an empty response.';
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
            logger()->error('Claude Exception', [
                'message' => $exception->getMessage(),
            ]);
            $reply = '⚠️ Error connecting to the AI service. Please check your internet connection.';
        }

        // 5. Add Claude's response to the chat
        $this->messages[] = [
            'role' => 'assistant',
            'text' => $reply,
        ];

        // 6. Tell AlpineJS (the frontend) to scroll the chat box to the bottom
        $this->dispatch('chatUpdated');
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.global-copilot');
    }
}

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const selectAll = document.getElementById('selectAllCheckbox');
            const rowCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox');
            const bulkActionBar = document.getElementById('bulkActionBar');
            const selectedCountDisplay = document.getElementById('selectedCount');
            const bulkActionSelect = document.getElementById('bulkActionSelect');

            function updateBulkBar() {
                const checkedCount = document.querySelectorAll('.row-checkbox:checked').length;
                selectedCountDisplay.textContent = checkedCount;

                if (checkedCount > 0) {
                    bulkActionBar.classList.remove('hidden');
                } else {
                    bulkActionBar.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (selectAll) selectAll.checked = false;
                    bulkActionSelect.selectedIndex = 0; // Reset dropdown
                }
            }

            if (selectAll) {
                selectAll.addEventListener('change', function() {
                    rowCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = this.checked);
                    updateBulkBar();
                });
            }

            rowCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
                cb.addEventListener('change', updateBulkBar);
            });
        });
    </script>
</x-app-layout>

    {{-- Lightweight enhancement: shows the chosen filename and supports drag & drop.
         Falls back gracefully — the input works even if this script doesn't run. --}}
    <script>
        (function() {
            var input = document.getElementById('sf1_file');
            var zone = document.getElementById('sf1-dropzone');
            var label = document.getElementById('sf1-filename');
            if (!input || !zone || !label) return;

            function showName(name) {
                label.textContent = name || 'Choose a file or drag it here…';
                label.classList.toggle('text-indigo-700', !!name);
            }

            input.addEventListener('change', function() {
                showName(input.files && input.files[0] ? input.files[0].name : '');
            });

            ['dragenter', 'dragover'].forEach(function(evt) {
                zone.addEventListener(evt, function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    zone.classList.add('border-indigo-400', 'bg-indigo-50/40');
                });
            });

            ['dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(function(evt) {
                zone.addEventListener(evt, function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    zone.classList.remove('border-indigo-400', 'bg-indigo-50/40');
                });
            });

            zone.addEventListener('drop', function(e) {
                if (e.dataTransfer && e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files.length) {
                    input.files = e.dataTransfer.files;
                    showName(e.dataTransfer.files[0].name);
                }
            });
        })();
    </script>
</x-app-layout>

FILE: resources/views/components/modal.blade.php
==================================================

@props([
    'name',
    'show' => false,
    'maxWidth' => '2xl'
])

@php
$maxWidth = [
    'sm' => 'sm:max-w-sm',
    'md' => 'sm:max-w-md',
    'lg' => 'sm:max-w-lg',
    'xl' => 'sm:max-w-xl',
    '2xl' => 'sm:max-w-2xl',
][$maxWidth];
@endphp

<div
    x-data="{
        show: @js($show),
        focusables() {
            // All focusable element types...
            let selector = 'a, button, input:not([type=\'hidden\']), textarea, select, details, [tabindex]:not([tabindex=\'-1\'])'
            return [...$el.querySelectorAll(selector)]
                // All non-disabled elements...
                .filter(el => ! el.hasAttribute('disabled'))
        },
        firstFocusable() { return this.focusables()[0] },
        lastFocusable() { return this.focusables().slice(-1)[0] },
        nextFocusable() { return this.focusables()[this.nextFocusableIndex()] || this.firstFocusable() },
        prevFocusable() { return this.focusables()[this.prevFocusableIndex()] || this.lastFocusable() },
        nextFocusableIndex() { return (this.focusables().indexOf(document.activeElement) + 1) % (this.focusables().length + 1) },
        prevFocusableIndex() { return Math.max(0, this.focusables().indexOf(document.activeElement)) -1 },
    }"
    x-init="$watch('show', value => {
        if (value) {
            document.body.classList.add('overflow-y-hidden');
            {{ $attributes->has('focusable') ? 'setTimeout(() => firstFocusable().focus(), 100)' : '' }}
        } else {
            document.body.classList.remove('overflow-y-hidden');
        }
    })"
    x-on:open-modal.window="$event.detail == '{{ $name }}' ? show = true : null"
    x-on:close-modal.window="$event.detail == '{{ $name }}' ? show = false : null"
    x-on:close.stop="show = false"
    x-on:keydown.escape.window="show = false"
    x-on:keydown.tab.prevent="$event.shiftKey || nextFocusable().focus()"
    x-on:keydown.shift.tab.prevent="prevFocusable().focus()"
    x-show="show"
    class="fixed inset-0 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-6 sm:px-0 z-50"
    style="display: {{ $show ? 'block' : 'none' }};"
>
    <div
        x-show="show"
        class="fixed inset-0 transform transition-all"
        x-on:click="show = false"
        x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
        x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0"
        x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100"
        x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
        x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
        x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
    >
        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gray-500 opacity-75"></div>
    </div>

    <div
        x-show="show"
        class="mb-6 bg-white rounded-lg overflow-hidden shadow-xl transform transition-all sm:w-full {{ $maxWidth }} sm:mx-auto"
        x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
        x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
        x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
        x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
        x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
        x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
    >
        {{ $slot }}
    </div>
</div>

@php
    /**
     * Printable certificate template (HTML-first).
     */
    $studentName = $student->full_name ?? trim(($student->first_name ?? '') . ' ' . ($student->last_name ?? ''));
    $lrn = $student->lrn ?? '—';
    $grade = $student->grade_level ?? '—';
    $section = $student->section ?? '';
    $schoolYear = $student->school_year ?? '';
    $issuedDate = now()->format('F d, Y');

    // Identifiers
    $identifier = $student->id ?? substr($lrn, -6);
    $certificateNo = 'GM-' . now()->format('Y') . '-' . str_pad((int) $identifier, 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);

    // Format Meta
    $sectionLabel = trim((string) $section) !== '' ? "Section $section" : '';
    $gradeLabel = $grade !== '—' ? "Grade $grade" : '';
    $metaLine = trim(
        collect([$gradeLabel, $sectionLabel, $schoolYear ? "SY $schoolYear" : null])
            ->filter()
            ->implode(' • '),
    );

    // Dynamic Settings
    $schoolName = \App\Models\Setting::get('school_name', 'TrackEd Systems High School');
    $principalName = \App\Models\Setting::get('principal_name', 'School Principal');
    $counselorName = Auth::user() ? Auth::user()->first_name . ' ' . Auth::user()->last_name : 'Guidance Counselor';
    $hasCustomLogo = \App\Models\Setting::get('has_custom_logo') === 'true';
@endphp

    <script>
        // --- MULTI-SELECT STATE ---
        let selectedStudents = [];

        function handleInterventionChange() {
            const intervention = document.getElementById('intervention-select').value;
            const customContainer = document.getElementById('intervention-custom-container');
            const customInput = document.getElementById('intervention-custom-input');

            if (intervention === 'other') {
                customContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
                customInput.setAttribute('required', 'required');
            } else {
                customContainer.classList.add('hidden');
                customInput.removeAttribute('required');
                customInput.value = ''; // clear it out
            }
        }

        function handleSeverityChange() {
            const severity = document.getElementById('severity-select').value;
            const intervention = document.getElementById('intervention-select');
            const status = document.getElementById('status-select');
            const followupContainer = document.getElementById('followup-container');
            const notes = document.getElementById('notes-textarea');
            const scheduledAtInput = document.getElementById('scheduled-at-input');

            if (severity === 'critical') {
                intervention.value = 'external_escalation';
                status.value = 'turned_over';
                handleInterventionChange(); // Hide custom input if it was open

                followupContainer.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    followupContainer.style.display = 'none';
                }, 300);
                scheduledAtInput.value = '';

                notes.placeholder =
                    'Enter the external turnover details (e.g., Police blotter number, DSWD receiving officer)...';
            } else {
                followupContainer.style.display = 'block';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    followupContainer.style.opacity = '1';
                }, 10);
                notes.placeholder = "Document the student's response, agreements made, and specific next steps...";

                if (status.value === 'turned_over') status.value = 'in_intervention';
                if (intervention.value === 'external_escalation') intervention.value = '';
            }
        }

        // --- SEARCH LOGIC ---
        let searchTimeout;

        function debounceSearch() {
            clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
            searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                searchLisDatabase();
            }, 300);
        }

        async function searchLisDatabase() {
            const input = document.getElementById('lis-search-input').value.trim();
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('search-results-dropdown');
            const resultsList = document.getElementById('search-results-list');

            if (input.length >= 2) {
                dropdown.classList.remove('hidden');
                resultsList.innerHTML =
                    '<div class="px-6 py-8 text-sm font-bold text-rose-500 text-center">Querying Database...</div>';

                try {
                    const searchUrl = "{{ route('counselor.incidents.search_lis') }}?q=" + encodeURIComponent(input);
                    const response = await fetch(searchUrl, {
                        headers: {
                            'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                            'Accept': 'application/json'
                        }
                    });

                    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Server Error");
                    const data = await response.json();

                    if (data.length > 0) {
                        resultsList.innerHTML = data.map(student => {
                                const fullName = `${student.last_name || ''}, ${student.first_name || ''}`.trim();
                                // Don't show students already selected
                                if (selectedStudents.some(s => s.lrn === student.lrn)) return '';

                                return `
                                <button type="button" onclick="addStudent('${student.lrn}', '${fullName.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')" class="w-full text-left px-5 py-4 hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0 group focus:outline-none">
                                    <div>
                                        <div class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-rose-600">${fullName || 'No Name'}</div>
                                        <div class="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 mt-0.5">LRN: ${student.lrn}</div>
                                    </div>
                                </button>
                            `;
                            }).join('') ||
                            '<div class="px-6 py-8 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 text-center">Student already selected.</div>';
                    } else {
                        resultsList.innerHTML =
                            '<div class="px-6 py-8 text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 text-center">No records matched.</div>';
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    resultsList.innerHTML =
                        `<div class="px-6 py-6 text-sm text-red-500 text-center">Search failed.</div>`;
                }
            } else {
                dropdown.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }

        // Add a student to the array and UI
        function addStudent(lrn, name) {
            document.getElementById('search-results-dropdown').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('lis-search-input').value = '';
            document.getElementById('lis-search-input').focus();

            if (!selectedStudents.some(s => s.lrn === lrn)) {
                selectedStudents.push({
                    lrn,
                    name
                });
                renderSelectedStudents();
            }
        }

        // Remove a student from the array and UI
        function removeStudent(lrn) {
            selectedStudents = selectedStudents.filter(s => s.lrn !== lrn);
            renderSelectedStudents();
        }

        // Render the array to the screen and generate hidden inputs
        function renderSelectedStudents() {
            const container = document.getElementById('selected-students-container');
            const hiddenInputsContainer = document.getElementById('hidden-lrn-inputs');
            const formSection = document.getElementById('violation-form-section');
            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submit-btn');

            container.innerHTML = '';
            hiddenInputsContainer.innerHTML = '';

            if (selectedStudents.length > 0) {
                formSection.classList.remove('hidden');
                setTimeout(() => formSection.classList.remove('opacity-0'), 50);
                submitBtn.removeAttribute('disabled');
            } else {
                formSection.classList.add('opacity-0');
                setTimeout(() => formSection.classList.add('hidden'), 300);
                submitBtn.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
            }

            selectedStudents.forEach((student, index) => {
                // Generate UI Card
                container.innerHTML += `
                    <div class="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm">
                        <div class="flex items-center">
                            <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center font-bold mr-4">
                                ${index + 1}
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <div class="text-sm font-black text-slate-900">${student.name}</div>
                                <div class="text-xs font-medium text-slate-600">LRN: ${student.lrn}</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <button type="button" onclick="removeStudent('${student.lrn}')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:border-rose-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border border-slate-200 transition-colors shadow-sm">
                            Remove
                        </button>
                    </div>
                `;

                // Generate Hidden Input for Form Submit
                hiddenInputsContainer.innerHTML += `<input type="hidden" name="lrns[]" value="${student.lrn}">`;
            });
        }

        // Auto-loader for when arriving from the Violator Database
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const prefillLrn = urlParams.get('prefill_lrn');

            if (prefillLrn) {
                document.getElementById('lis-search-input').value = prefillLrn;
                await searchLisDatabase();
                const firstResult = document.querySelector('#search-results-list button');
                if (firstResult) firstResult.click();
            }
        });
    </script>
</x-app-layout>

    <script>
        // --- DYNAMIC FORM LOGIC ---
        function handleSeverityChange() {
            const severity = document.getElementById('severity-select').value;
            const intervention = document.getElementById('intervention-select');
            const status = document.getElementById('status-select');
            const followupContainer = document.getElementById('followup-container');
            const notes = document.getElementById('notes-textarea');
            const scheduledAtInput = document.getElementById('scheduled-at-input');

            if (severity === 'critical') {
                // Auto-fill and lock critical selections
                intervention.value = 'external_escalation';
                status.value = 'turned_over';

                // Hide follow-up calendar as it's out of counselor hands
                followupContainer.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    followupContainer.style.display = 'none';
                }, 300);
                scheduledAtInput.value = ''; // Clear any existing date

                // Prompt for legal documentation details if empty
                if (!notes.value) {
                    notes.placeholder =
                        'Enter the external turnover details (e.g., Police blotter number, DSWD receiving officer, Barangay blotter)...';
                }
            } else {
                // Restore form for normal internal tracking
                followupContainer.style.display = 'block';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    followupContainer.style.opacity = '1';
                }, 10);

                // Reset text placeholder
                notes.placeholder = "Document the student's response, agreements made, and specific next steps...";
            }
        }

        // Run on load to ensure the form is correctly displayed if editing an existing critical incident
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            handleSeverityChange();
        });
    </script>
</x-app-layout>

    <script>
        function filterIncidents() {
            const input = document.getElementById('incident-search').value.toLowerCase();
            const cards = document.getElementsByClassName('incident-card');

            for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
                const text = cards[i].innerText.toLowerCase();
                cards[i].style.display = text.includes(input) ? "" : "none";
            }
        }
    </script>

            const element = document.getElementById('cot-form-content');

            const opt = {
                margin: 0,
                filename: '{{ $fileName }}',
                image: {
                    type: 'jpeg',
                    quality: 1
                },
                html2canvas: {
                    scale: 2,
                    useCORS: true
                },
                jsPDF: {
                    unit: 'in',
                    format: 'letter',
                    orientation: 'portrait'
                }
            };

            html2pdf().set(opt).from(element).save().then(() => {
                document.getElementById('loading-screen').innerHTML =
                    '<h2 class="text-xl font-black text-emerald-600">Download Complete!</h2>' +
                    '<p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-2">You can close this tab.</p>';

                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.close();
                }, 1500);
            });
        };
    </script>

                    playsinline></video>

                    class="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-black text-sm px-6 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-md transition-transform active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <div class="w-3 h-3 bg-white rounded-full animate-pulse"></div>
                    Snap & Scan
                </button>
            </div>

    <script>
        let videoStream = null;

        async function openWebcam() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('webcamModal');
            const video = document.getElementById('webcamVideo');
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');

            try {
                videoStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
                    video: {
                        facingMode: "environment",
                        width: {
                            ideal: 1920
                        },
                        height: {
                            ideal: 1080
                        }
                    }
                });
                video.srcObject = videoStream;
            } catch (err) {
                alert("Camera access denied or unavailable. Please check your browser permissions.");
                closeWebcam();
            }
        }

        function closeWebcam() {
            document.getElementById('webcamModal').classList.add('hidden');
            if (videoStream) {
                videoStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
                videoStream = null;
            }
        }

        function takeSnapshot() {
            const snapBtn = document.getElementById('snapButton');
            snapBtn.innerHTML = 'Scanning with AI...';
            snapBtn.classList.add('opacity-75', 'cursor-not-allowed');

            const video = document.getElementById('webcamVideo');
            const canvas = document.getElementById('webcamCanvas');
            const input = document.getElementById('cot_image_input');

            canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
            canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
            canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0);

            canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
                const file = new File([blob], "scanned_cot_" + Date.now() + ".jpg", {
                    type: "image/jpeg"
                });

                const dataTransfer = new DataTransfer();
                dataTransfer.items.add(file);
                input.files = dataTransfer.files;

                closeWebcam();

                // Show loading state on main upload button as well
                const mainSubmitBtn = document.getElementById('scanSubmitBtn');
                if (mainSubmitBtn) {
                    mainSubmitBtn.innerHTML = 'Scanning with AI...';
                    mainSubmitBtn.classList.add('opacity-75', 'cursor-not-allowed');
                }

                input.closest('form').submit();

            }, 'image/jpeg', 0.95);
        }
    </script>
</x-app-layout>

    <script>
        function reviewAssistant(apiUrl) {
            return {
                endpoint: apiUrl,
                isGenerating: false,
                aiBrief: '',
                suggestedFeedback: '',

                async generateBrief() {
                    this.isGenerating = true;
                    this.aiBrief = '';

                    try {
                        let response = await fetch(this.endpoint, {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: {
                                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                                'X-CSRF-TOKEN': document.getElementById('csrf_token').value,
                                'Accept': 'application/json'
                            }
                        });

                        // 1. Check if Laravel threw a 500 Server Error
                        if (!response.ok) {
                            let errorData = await response.json();
                            throw new Error(errorData.message || "Laravel Server Error " + response.status);
                        }

                        // 2. Parse the successful JSON
                        let data = await response.json();
                        this.aiBrief = data.brief;

                        if (data.suggested_feedback) {
                            this.suggestedFeedback = data.suggested_feedback;
                        }

                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error("Smart Engine Error:", error);
                        // Print the exact error to the UI so we can see it!
                        this.aiBrief = "⚠️ Error: " + error.message +
                            ". (Check your terminal or browser console for details).";
                    } finally {
                        this.isGenerating = false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    </script>
</x-app-layout>

                            // Check if the teacher saved an entry for this specific day of the week
                            $hasEntry = $log->entries->contains(function ($entry) use ($day) {

                            });
                        @endphp

                    @elseif($log->status === 'checked')
                        Checked & Noted
                    @endif
                </td>
            </tr>
        @endforeach

        <!-- Blank Row Separator Between Teachers -->

    @endforeach

            </h2>
        </div>
    </x-slot>

    <div class="py-8 max-w-4xl mx-auto sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div class="bg-white p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 border-t-4 border-t-rose-500">

            <div class="mb-6 border-b border-slate-100 pb-5">
                <h3 class="text-lg font-black text-slate-800">Behavioral Intake Form</h3>
                <p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">Search the LIS directory to flag one or multiple students for an
                    active deviation. You may optionally attach photo evidence.</p>
            </div>

            {{-- ⚠️ CRITICAL: enctype="multipart/form-data" is required for file uploads --}}
            <form action="{{ route('teacher.behavior.store') }}" method="POST" enctype="multipart/form-data">
                @csrf
                <input type="hidden" name="reported_by"
                    value="{{ Auth::user()->first_name ?? 'Faculty' }} {{ Auth::user()->last_name ?? '' }}">

                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">

                    {{-- ======================================================== --}}
                    {{-- 🚀 ALPINE.JS CUSTOM SEARCHABLE MULTI-SELECT WIDGET       --}}
                    {{-- ======================================================== --}}
                    <div class="col-span-1 md:col-span-2 relative" x-data="{
                        search: '',
                        open: false,
                        selectedIds: [],
                        options: [
                            @foreach ($enrolledStudents as $student)
                                {
                                    id: {{ $student->id }},
                                    name: '{{ addslashes($student->last_name) }}, {{ addslashes($student->first_name) }}',
                                    details: 'Grade {{ $student->grade_level }} - {{ $student->section }}'
                                }, @endforeach
                        ],
                        get filteredOptions() {
                            if (this.search === '') return this.options;
                            return this.options.filter(opt =>
                                opt.name.toLowerCase().includes(this.search.toLowerCase()) ||
                                opt.details.toLowerCase().includes(this.search.toLowerCase())
                            );
                        },
                        toggle(id) {
                            if (this.selectedIds.includes(id)) {
                                this.selectedIds = this.selectedIds.filter(i => i !== id);
                            } else {
                                this.selectedIds.push(id);
                            }
                            this.$refs.searchInput.focus();
                        },
                        isSelected(id) {
                            return this.selectedIds.includes(id);
                        },
                        getSelectedItems() {
                            return this.options.filter(opt => this.selectedIds.includes(opt.id));
                        }
                    }">
                        <label class="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500 mb-2 ml-1">
                            Target Student(s) (Search LIS Directory)
                        </label>

                        {{-- Hidden inputs to actually submit the data to Laravel --}}
                        <template x-for="item in getSelectedItems()" :key="item.id">
                            <input type="hidden" name="student_ids[]" :value="item.id">
                        </template>

                        {{-- The Search Box & Selected Pills Display --}}
                        <div @click.away="open = false" class="relative">
                            <div class="w-full min-h-[52px] rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 shadow-sm transition-all focus-within:bg-white focus-within:border-indigo-500 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-indigo-200 flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center cursor-text"
                                @click="open = true; $refs.searchInput.focus()">

                                {{-- Render Selected Tags (Pills) --}}
                                <template x-for="item in getSelectedItems()" :key="item.id">

                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <!-- WIZARD CONTROLS -->
                    <div class="bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200 p-6 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <button type="button" @click="step--" x-show="step === 2"
                            class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest transition-all shadow-sm">

                        </button>

                                Next: Daily Matrix →

                                class="px-8 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest transition-all shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/30">
                                Save & Initialize Log
                            </button>
                        </div>
